title.zh: 卷三百十二 列傳第二百 四川土司二
title.raw: 卷三百十二 列傳第二百 四川土司二 Volume 312 Biographies 200: Sichuan Tribal Headmen 2

sentences.zh: 播州宣慰司永寧宣撫司酉陽宣撫司石砫宣撫司

translations.literal: Bozhou Pacification Commissioner's Office, Yongning Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office, Youyang Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office, Shizhu Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office
translations.idiomatic: Bozhou Pacification Commissioner's Office; Yongning Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office; Youyang Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office; Shizhu Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office

sentences.zh: 播州宣慰司

translations.literal: Bozhou Pacification Commissioner's Office
translations.idiomatic: The Bozhou Pacification Commissioner's Office

sentences.zh: 遵義府即播州。

translations.literal: Zunyi Prefecture is Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zunyi Prefecture is the former Bozhou region.

sentences.zh: 秦為夜郎且蘭地。

translations.literal: Under Qin it was the land of Yelang and Qielan.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qin period it was the territory of Yelang and Qielan.

sentences.zh: 漢屬牂牁。

translations.literal: Under Han it belonged to Zangke.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it fell within Zangke commandery.

sentences.zh: 唐貞觀中，改播州。

translations.literal: In the Zhenguan era of Tang it was changed to Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenguan reign of the Tang it was redesignated Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 乾符初，南詔陷播，太原楊端應募復其城，為播人所懷服，歷五代，子孫世有其地。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianfu, Nanzhao seized Bozhou; Yang Duan of Taiyuan answered the recruitment call and recovered its city, and the people of Bozhou came to revere and submit to him; through the Five Dynasties his descendants held the land in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianfu era, Nanzhao overran Bozhou. Yang Duan of Taiyuan answered the call to arms and recovered the city, winning the loyalty of the Bozhou people. Through the Five Dynasties his line held the region in unbroken succession.

sentences.zh: 宋大觀中，楊文貴納土，置遵義軍。

translations.literal: In the Daguan era of Song, Yang Wengui surrendered the territory and the Zunyi Army was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the Daguan era of the Song, Yang Wengui surrendered his domain, and the court established the Zunyi Army there.

sentences.zh: 元世祖授楊邦憲宣慰使，賜其子漢英名賽因不花，封播國公。

translations.literal: Yuan Shizu appointed Yang Bangxian Pacification Commissioner, granted his son Hanying the name Sayinbuqa, and enfeoffed him as Duke of the Bo State.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai Khan appointed Yang Bangxian Pacification Commissioner, gave his son Hanying the Mongol name Sayinbuqa, and enfeoffed him as Duke of Bo.

sentences.zh: 洪武四年平蜀，遣使諭之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Hongwu Shu was pacified and envoys were sent to instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: When Shu was pacified in the fourth year of Hongwu, the court sent envoys to announce its will to them.

sentences.zh: 五年，播州宣慰使楊鏗、同知羅琛、總管何嬰、蠻夷總管鄭瑚等，相率來歸，貢方物，納元所授金牌、銀印、銅章。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Bozhou Pacification Commissioner Yang Keng, Vice Commissioner Luo Chen, Chief Administrator He Ying, Barbarian Chief Administrator Zheng Hu, and others came in succession to submit, presented local products, and surrendered the gold plaques, silver seals, and bronze seals conferred by the Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Bozhou Pacification Commissioner Yang Keng, Vice Commissioner Luo Chen, Chief Administrator He Ying, Barbarian Chief Administrator Zheng Hu, and others led their people in to submit. They presented local tribute and handed over the gold plaques, silver seals, and bronze seals the Yuan had granted them.

sentences.zh: 詔賜鏗衣幣，仍置播州宣慰使司，鏗、琛皆仍舊職。

translations.literal: An edict granted Keng robes and silks, re-established the Bozhou Pacification Commissioner's Office, and both Keng and Chen retained their former posts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted Keng robes and silks, restored the Bozhou Pacification Commissioner's Office, and confirmed Keng and Chen in their former offices.

sentences.zh: 領安撫司二，曰草塘，曰黃平；

translations.literal: It oversaw two Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Offices, called Caotang and Huangping;
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw two Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Offices, Caotang and Huangping;

sentences.zh: 長官司六，曰真州，曰播州，曰余慶，曰白泥，曰容山，曰重安。

translations.literal: and six Native Official Offices, called Zhenzhou, Bozhou, Yuqing, Baini, Rongshan, and Chong'an.
translations.idiomatic: and six Native Official Offices: Zhenzhou, Bozhou, Yuqing, Baini, Rongshan, and Chong'an.

sentences.zh: 以嬰等為長官。

translations.literal: Ying and the others were made native officials.
translations.idiomatic: He Ying and the others were appointed native officials.

sentences.zh: 七年，中書省奏：「播州土地既入版圖，當收其貢賦，歲納糧二千五百石為軍儲。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Secretariat memorialized: "Now that Bozhou's land has entered the realm's maps, its tribute and taxes should be collected; it should pay two thousand five hundred piculs of grain yearly as military stores."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the Secretariat memorialized: "Now that Bozhou has been brought within the realm, its tribute and taxes should be collected. It ought to deliver two thousand five hundred piculs of grain each year for military stores."

sentences.zh: 」帝以其率先來歸，田稅隨所入，不必以額。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because they had been the first to come in, ordered that field tax follow actual yield and need not meet a fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Because they had been the first to submit, the Emperor ruled that their land tax should follow whatever they actually produced and need not meet a fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 已，復置播州黃平宣撫司。

translations.literal: Thereafter the Bozhou Huangping Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Bozhou Huangping Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office was restored.

sentences.zh: 播州江渡蠻黃安作亂，貴州衛指揮張岱討平之。

translations.literal: The Bozhou Jiangdu barbarian Huang An rebelled; Zhang Dai, commander of Guizhou Guard, suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: The Bozhou Jiangdu tribesman Huang An rose in revolt. Zhang Dai, commander of Guizhou Guard, put down the disturbance.

sentences.zh: 八年，鏗遣其弟锜來貢，賜衣幣。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Keng sent his younger brother Qi to present tribute and robes and silks were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Keng sent his younger brother Qi to court with tribute, and the court granted robes and silks.

sentences.zh: 自是，每三歲一入貢。

translations.literal: From then on tribute was presented once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: From then on they presented tribute once every three years.

sentences.zh: 十四年遣使賫敕諭鏗：「比聞爾聽浮言，生疑貳。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year envoys were sent bearing an edict instructing Keng: "We have lately heard that you listen to idle talk and harbor doubts of disloyalty."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year envoys were sent with an edict to Keng: "We have lately heard that you lend ear to idle rumors and are growing doubtful and disloyal."

sentences.zh: 今大軍南征，多用戰騎，宜率兵二萬、馬三千為先鋒，庶表爾誠。

translations.literal: Now the great army is campaigning south and relies heavily on war horses; you should lead twenty thousand troops and three thousand horses as vanguard, so as to show your sincerity."
translations.idiomatic: The great army is now campaigning in the south and needs many war horses. You should lead twenty thousand troops and three thousand horses as the vanguard, so that your loyalty may be plain."

sentences.zh: 」十五年城播州沙溪，以官兵一千人、土兵二千人戍之。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the Bozhou fortress at Shaxi was built and garrisoned with one thousand regular troops and two thousand native troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year a walled post was built at Shaxi in Bozhou and garrisoned with one thousand regular troops and two thousand native levies.

sentences.zh: 改播州宣慰司隸貴州，改黃平衛為千戶所。

translations.literal: The Bozhou Pacification Commissioner's Office was transferred to Guizhou jurisdiction, and Huangping Guard was changed to a battalion.
translations.idiomatic: The Bozhou Pacification Commissioner's Office was placed under Guizhou, and Huangping Guard was reduced to a battalion.

sentences.zh: 十七年，鏗子震卒於京，命有司歸其喪。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Keng's son Zhen died in the capital and the authorities were ordered to return his coffin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Keng's son Zhen died in the capital, and the court ordered the authorities to return his body for burial.

sentences.zh: 二十年征鏗入朝，貢馬十匹。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Keng was summoned to court and presented ten horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Keng was summoned to court, where he presented ten horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 帝諭以守土保身之道，賜鈔五百錠。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed him in the way to guard his domain and preserve himself, and granted five hundred ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor lectured him on how to hold his territory and keep himself safe, and granted him five hundred ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，播州宣慰使司並所屬宣撫司官，各遣其子來朝，請入太學，帝敕國子監官善訓導之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the officials of the Bozhou Pacification Commissioner's Office and its subordinate Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Offices each sent their sons to court, requesting admission to the Imperial Academy; the Emperor ordered the Directorate of Education to train and guide them well.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year the officials of the Bozhou Pacification Commissioner's Office and its subordinate Pacification Assistant offices each sent their sons to court and asked that they enter the Imperial Academy. The Emperor ordered the Directorate of Education to instruct them properly.

sentences.zh: 永樂四年免播州荒田租，設重安長官司，隸播州宣慰司，以張佛保為長官，以佛保嘗招輯重安蠻民向化故也。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongle rent on Bozhou's wasteland was remitted; the Chong'an Native Official Office was established under the Bozhou Pacification Commissioner's Office, with Zhang Fobao as native official, because Fobao had once gathered and settled the Chong'an barbarians toward civilization.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yongle, rent on Bozhou wasteland was remitted. The Chong'an Native Official Office was established under the Bozhou Pacification Commissioner's Office, with Zhang Fobao as native official, because he had once won over and settled the Chong'an tribes.

sentences.zh: 七年，宣慰使楊升招諭草塘、黃平、重安所轄當科、葛雍等十二寨蠻人來歸。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Pacification Commissioner Yang Sheng summoned and instructed the barbarians of twelve stockades under Caotang, Huangping, and Chong'an, including Dangke and Geyong, to come in.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Pacification Commissioner Yang Sheng summoned and persuaded the tribes of twelve stockades under Caotang, Huangping, and Chong'an, including Dangke and Geyong, to submit.

sentences.zh: 宣德三年，升賀萬壽節後期，禮部議予半賞。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuande, Sheng arrived late for the Emperor's birthday congratulations; the Ministry of Rites proposed granting half the reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuande, Sheng arrived late for the imperial birthday audience. The Ministry of Rites proposed granting only half the usual reward.

sentences.zh: 帝以道遠，勿奪其賜。

translations.literal: The Emperor, considering the distance, ordered that his reward not be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, mindful of the distance, ordered that his full reward not be withheld.

sentences.zh: 七年，草塘所屬谷亻散等四十一寨蠻作亂，總兵陳懷剿撫之，旋定。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the barbarians of forty-one stockades under Caotang, including Gusai, rebelled; Grand Commander Chen Huai suppressed and pacified them, and the disturbance was soon settled.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the tribes of forty-one stockades under Caotang, including Gusai, rose in revolt. Grand Commander Chen Huai suppressed and pacified them, and order was soon restored.

sentences.zh: 正統十四年，宣慰使楊綱老疾，以其子輝代。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Zhengtong, Pacification Commissioner Yang Gang, old and ill, had his son Hui act in his place.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Zhengtong, Pacification Commissioner Yang Gang, aged and infirm, had his son Hui act in his stead.

sentences.zh: 景泰三年，輝奏：「湖、貴所轄臻、剖、五坌等苗賊，糾合草塘、江渡諸苗黃龍、韋保等，殺掠人民，屢撫復叛，乞調兵征剿，以靖民患。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingtai, Hui memorialized: "The Miao bandits under Huguang and Guizhou jurisdiction, including Zhen, Pou, and Wuben, have joined with the Miao Huang Long and Wei Bao of Caotang, Jiangdu, and other places to kill and plunder the people. Though repeatedly pacified they rebel again. I beg that troops be mobilized to campaign against them and settle the people's distress."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jingtai, Hui memorialized: "The Miao rebels in the domains of Huguang and Guizhou, including Zhen, Pou, and Wuben, have joined Huang Long, Wei Bao, and others from Caotang and Jiangdu in killing and plundering the people. Though repeatedly pacified they rebel again. I beg that troops be sent to campaign against them and end the people's suffering."

sentences.zh: 」帝命總督王來、總兵梁缶等，會同四川巡撫剿之。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Grand Coordinator Wang Lai, Grand Commander Liang Fou, and others, together with the Sichuan grand coordinator, to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Grand Coordinator Wang Lai, Grand Commander Liang Fou, and others, together with the Sichuan grand coordinator, to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 七年，調輝兵征銅鼓、五開叛苗，賜敕頒賞。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Hui's troops were mobilized to campaign against the rebellious Miao of Tonggu and Wukai, and an edict with rewards was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Hui's troops were mobilized against the rebellious Miao of Tonggu and Wukai, and the court issued an edict with rewards.

sentences.zh: 成化十年以播州賊賫果等屢歲為患，敕責川、貴鎮巡官。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Chenghua, because the Bozhou bandit Ziguo and others had been a trouble for years, an edict rebuked the frontier officials of Sichuan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Chenghua, because the Bozhou rebel Ziguo and his followers had troubled the region for years, an edict rebuked the frontier officials of Sichuan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 正統末，苗蠻聚眾寇邊，土官同知羅宏奏，輝有疾，乞以其子愛代。

translations.literal: Late in Zhengtong, Miao and barbarians gathered in force to raid the border; Native Vice Commissioner Luo Hong memorialized that Hui was ill and begged that his son Ai act in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Zhengtong, Miao and other tribesmen gathered to raid the frontier. Native Vice Commissioner Luo Hong memorialized that Hui was ill and asked that his son Ai succeed him.

sentences.zh: 帝命愛襲職，仍敕愛即率兵從總兵官剿賊。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Ai to inherit the office and also commanded Ai immediately to lead troops with the grand commander to suppress the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Ai to inherit the office and commanded him at once to lead troops with the grand commander against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 先是，輝奏所屬夭壩幹地五十三寨及重安所轄灣溪等寨，屢被苗蠻占據，乞令湖、貴會兵征之。

translations.literal: Earlier Hui had memorialized that fifty-three stockades of Yaobagan in his jurisdiction and stockades such as Wanxi under Chong'an had repeatedly been occupied by Miao and barbarians, and begged that Huguang and Guizhou join forces to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Hui had memorialized that fifty-three stockades at Yaobagan in his domain and stockades such as Wanxi under Chong'an had repeatedly been seized by Miao tribes, and asked that Huguang and Guizhou join forces to campaign against them.

sentences.zh: 命如輝言。

translations.literal: The order followed Hui's request.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved Hui's request.

sentences.zh: 部議以愛年幼，請仍起輝暫理軍事。

translations.literal: The ministry proposed that because Ai was young, Hui should still be recalled to manage military affairs for the time being.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry proposed that because Ai was young, Hui should be recalled temporarily to manage military affairs.

sentences.zh: 又以輝難獨任，宜敕都御史張瓚親至播州督理，勵輝等振揚威武，以備征調，其機宜悉聽瓚裁處。

translations.literal: Also, because Hui could hardly bear the burden alone, Censor-in-Chief Zhang Zan should be ordered to go in person to Bozhou to supervise, encourage Hui and the others to display martial vigor in preparation for mobilization, and all operational decisions were to be left to Zhang Zan's discretion.
translations.idiomatic: Because Hui could hardly manage alone, the court also ordered Censor-in-Chief Zhang Zan to go in person to Bozhou to supervise, urged Hui and his men to show martial vigor in readiness for mobilization, and left all operational decisions to Zhang Zan's discretion.

sentences.zh: 十二年，瓚督諸軍及輝攻敗灣溪、夭壩幹地諸苗，凡破山寨十六，斬首四百九十六級，撫男婦九千八百余口。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Zhang supervised the armies and, with Hui, defeated the Miao of Wanxi, Yaobagan, and other places; in all sixteen mountain stockades were taken, four hundred ninety-six heads were cut off, and more than nine thousand eight hundred men and women were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Zhang directed the armies and, with Hui, defeated the Miao of Wanxi, Yaobagan, and other places. Sixteen mountain stockades were taken, four hundred ninety-six heads were cut off, and more than nine thousand eight hundred men and women were pacified.

sentences.zh: 事下兵部，以苗就撫者多，宜量為處分。

translations.literal: The matter was sent down to the Ministry of War, which held that because many Miao had submitted, disposition should be made according to circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: The matter went to the Ministry of War, which held that because many Miao had submitted, they should be dealt with according to circumstances.

sentences.zh: 瓚議設安寧宣撫司，並懷遠、宣化二長官司，建靖南、龍場二堡，命輝董其役。

translations.literal: Zhang proposed establishing the Anning Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office, together with the Huaiyuan and Xuanhua Native Official Offices, and building the forts Jingnan and Longchang; Hui was ordered to oversee the work.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang proposed establishing the Anning Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office, together with the Huaiyuan and Xuanhua Native Official Offices, and building the forts at Jingnan and Longchang. Hui was ordered to oversee the work.

sentences.zh: 輝調兵民五千余，立治所，委所屬黃平諸長官，分甓城垣。

translations.literal: Hui mobilized more than five thousand soldiers and civilians, set up administrative seats, assigned the Huangping native officials under him, and divided the work of laying city walls.
translations.idiomatic: Hui mobilized more than five thousand soldiers and civilians, established administrative seats, assigned the Huangping native officials under him, and divided the work of building the city walls.

sentences.zh: 將竣，輝因奏：「各寨苗蠻，近頗知懼，但大軍還後，難保無虞。

translations.literal: As the work neared completion, Hui memorialized: "The Miao and barbarians of the various stockades have lately grown somewhat fearful, but after the great army withdraws it will be hard to guarantee no trouble."
translations.idiomatic: As the work neared completion, Hui memorialized: "The Miao of the various stockades have lately grown somewhat fearful, but once the main army withdraws we cannot be sure there will be no trouble."

sentences.zh: 播州向設操守土兵一千五百人，今撥守懷遠、靖南、夭漂、龍場各二百人，宣化百人，安寧六百人，其家屬宜徙之同居，為固守計。

translations.literal: Bozhou had formerly stationed one thousand five hundred garrison native troops; now two hundred are to guard each of Huaiyuan, Jingnan, Yaopiao, and Longchang, one hundred Xuanhua, and six hundred Anning; their families should be moved to live with them as a plan for firm defense.
translations.idiomatic: Bozhou had formerly maintained one thousand five hundred garrison native troops. I propose posting two hundred at each of Huaiyuan, Jingnan, Yaopiao, and Longchang, one hundred at Xuanhua, and six hundred at Anning, and moving their families to live with them as a plan for firm defense.

sentences.zh: 其工之未畢者，宜命臣子愛董之，而聽臣致仕如故。

translations.literal: For work not yet finished, my son Ai should be ordered to oversee it, while I am permitted to retire as before.
translations.idiomatic: For work not yet finished, my son Ai should oversee it, while I am permitted to retire as before.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved his request.

sentences.zh: 時灣溪既立安寧宣撫，爛土諸蠻惡其逼，遂引賫果等攻陷夭漂、靖南城堡，圍安寧。

translations.literal: At that time, since Wanxi had established the Anning Pacification Assistant Commission, the barbarians of Lantu resented the pressure and therefore induced Ziguo and others to attack and take the forts at Yaopiao and Jingnan and besiege Anning.
translations.idiomatic: By then Wanxi had established the Anning Pacification Assistant Commission, and the Lantu tribes, resenting the pressure, induced Ziguo and others to storm the forts at Yaopiao and Jingnan and besiege Anning.

sentences.zh: 愛新襲，力弗能支，求援於川、貴二鎮。

translations.literal: Ai had newly inherited the office and could not hold out; he sought aid from the two frontier commands of Sichuan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ai had only recently inherited the office and could not hold out. He sought aid from the frontier commands of Sichuan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 兵部奏起輝再統兵剿之，又敕川、貴兵為助。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War memorialized to recall Hui to command troops again to suppress them, and also ordered Sichuan and Guizhou troops to assist.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War memorialized to recall Hui to command troops again, and also ordered Sichuan and Guizhou troops to assist.

sentences.zh: 十五年，貴州巡撫陳儼奏：「苗賊賫果轉橫，乞調川、湖等官軍五萬五千，剋期會貴州，聽儼節制。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Guizhou Grand Coordinator Chen Yan memorialized: "The Miao bandit Ziguo grows ever more rampant; I beg that fifty-five thousand regular troops from Sichuan, Huguang, and elsewhere be mobilized to assemble in Guizhou on a set date under Yan's command."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Guizhou Grand Coordinator Chen Yan memorialized: "The Miao rebel Ziguo grows ever more rampant. I beg that fifty-five thousand regular troops from Sichuan, Huguang, and elsewhere be mobilized to assemble in Guizhou on a set date under my command."

sentences.zh: 」兵部言：「賊作於四川，而貴州守臣自欲節制諸軍，恐有邀功之人主之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said: "The bandits arose in Sichuan, yet the Guizhou frontier official himself wishes to command all the armies; I fear someone eager for merit is directing affairs."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War replied: "The rebels arose in Sichuan, yet the Guizhou official himself wishes to command all the armies. I fear someone eager for credit is steering the campaign."

sentences.zh: 且興師五萬，以半年計，須軍儲十三萬五千石，山路險峻，輸運之夫須二十七萬眾，況天將暑，瘴癘可虞。

translations.literal: Moreover, to raise an army of fifty thousand, counting half a year, would require one hundred thirty-five thousand piculs of military grain; the mountain roads are steep and dangerous and would need two hundred seventy thousand transport laborers; moreover summer is coming and miasma is to be feared.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, raising fifty thousand troops for half a year would require one hundred thirty-five thousand piculs of grain. The mountain roads are steep and dangerous and would need two hundred seventy thousand transport laborers. Summer is coming, and miasma is to be feared.

sentences.zh: 」帝然其奏。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved this memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved the ministry's memorial.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，愛兄宣撫楊友訐奏愛，帝命刑部侍郎何喬新往勘。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year Ai's elder brother, Pacification Assistant Commissioner Yang You, accused Ai in a petition; the Emperor ordered Vice Minister of Justice He Qiaoxin to go investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year Ai's elder brother, Pacification Assistant Commissioner Yang You, accused Ai in a petition. The Emperor ordered Vice Minister of Justice He Qiaoxin to investigate.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，喬新奏：「輝在日，溺其庶子友，欲令承襲，長官張淵阿順之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Qiaoxin memorialized: "While Hui was alive he doted on his son by a concubine, You, and wished him to inherit; Native Official Zhang Yuan flattered and followed this."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Qiaoxin memorialized: "While Hui was alive he favored his son by a concubine, You, and wished him to inherit. Native Official Zhang Yuan flattered and supported this plan."

sentences.zh: 安撫宋韜謂楊氏家法，立嗣以嫡，愛宜立。

translations.literal: Pacification Assistant Commissioner Song Tao said that by the Yang family law the heir should be the son of the principal wife and Ai ought to be established.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Assistant Commissioner Song Tao said that by Yang family law the heir must be the son of the principal wife, and that Ai ought to succeed.

sentences.zh: 輝不得已立愛，又欲割地以授友，謀於淵，因以夭壩幹乃本州懷遠故地，為生苗所據，請兵取之。

translations.literal: Hui had no choice but to establish Ai, yet also wished to carve off land to give You; he plotted with Yuan, and on the grounds that Yaobagan was former Huaiyuan territory of this prefecture now held by raw Miao, requested troops to take it.
translations.idiomatic: Hui had no choice but to establish Ai, yet also wished to carve off land for You. He plotted with Yuan, claiming that Yaobagan was former Huaiyuan territory now held by unsubdued Miao, and asked for troops to seize it.

sentences.zh: 容山長官韓瑄以土民安輯日久，不宜征。

translations.literal: Rongshan Native Official Han Xuan held that the native people had long been settled and that campaigning was inappropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Rongshan Native Official Han Xuan argued that the native people had long been settled and that a campaign was inappropriate.

sentences.zh: 淵與輝計執瑄，杖殺之。

translations.literal: Yuan and Hui plotted, seized Xuan, and beat him to death.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan and Hui plotted together, seized Xuan, and beat him to death.

sentences.zh: 前巡撫張瓚受輝賂，以其地設安寧宣撫司，冒以友任宣撫。

translations.literal: The former grand coordinator Zhang Zan had accepted bribes from Hui, established the Anning Pacification Assistant Commission on that land, and falsely had You appointed Pacification Assistant Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Former Grand Coordinator Zhang Zan had accepted bribes from Hui, established the Anning Pacification Assistant Commission on that land, and falsely appointed You as Pacification Assistant Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 輝立券，以所有金玉、服用、莊田召諸子均分之。

translations.literal: Hui drew up a deed summoning his sons to divide equally all gold and jade, clothing and utensils, and estates that he possessed.
translations.idiomatic: Hui drew up a deed calling his sons to divide equally all his gold and jade, clothing and furnishings, and estates.

sentences.zh: 輝沒，淵乃與友潛謀刺愛，淵弟深亦與謀，不果，友遂奏愛居處器用僭擬朝廷，又通唐府，密書往來，私習兵法、天文，謀不軌，事皆誣。

translations.literal: After Hui died, Yuan then secretly plotted with You to assassinate Ai; Yuan's younger brother Shen also joined the plot but it failed; You then memorialized that Ai's dwelling and utensils imitated the court, that he also communicated with the Princedom of Tang, exchanged secret letters, privately studied military arts and astronomy, and plotted rebellion—all false.
translations.idiomatic: After Hui died, Yuan secretly plotted with You to assassinate Ai. Yuan's younger brother Shen joined the plot, but it failed. You then memorialized that Ai's dwelling and furnishings imitated the court, that he communicated with the Princedom of Tang, exchanged secret letters, and privately studied military arts and astronomy in a plot of rebellion—all false.

sentences.zh: 」帝命斬淵、深。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Yuan and Shen beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Yuan and Shen beheaded.

sentences.zh: 以愛信讒薄兄，友因公擅殺，且謀嫡，盜官錢，皆有罪。

translations.literal: Because Ai believed slander and treated his elder brother harshly, and You on official business killed without authority, plotted against the legitimate heir, and embezzled official funds, all were guilty.
translations.idiomatic: Ai was guilty for believing slander and treating his elder brother harshly. You was guilty for killing without authority on official business, plotting against the legitimate heir, and embezzling official funds.

sentences.zh: 愛贖復任，友遷保寧羈管，仍敕喬新從宜處治。

translations.literal: Ai ransomed his way back to office; You was transferred to detention at Baoning; and Qiaoxin was still ordered to dispose as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Ai paid a fine and resumed office. You was transferred to detention at Baoning. Qiaoxin was still ordered to dispose of the matter as he saw fit.

sentences.zh: 正德二年升播州宣慰使楊斌為四川按察使，仍理宣慰事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengde the Bozhou Pacification Commissioner Yang Bin was promoted to Sichuan Surveillance Commissioner while still administering Pacification Commissioner affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhengde, Bozhou Pacification Commissioner Yang Bin was promoted to Sichuan Surveillance Commissioner while continuing to administer Pacification Commissioner affairs.

sentences.zh: 舊制，土官有功，賜衣帶，或旌賞部眾，無列銜方面者。

translations.literal: By old regulation, when native officials had merit they were granted robes and belts, or their followers were rewarded; none were given provincial rank.
translations.idiomatic: By longstanding practice, when native officials performed meritorious service they were granted robes and belts, or their followers were rewarded. None had been given provincial rank.

sentences.zh: 斌狡橫，不受兩司節制，諷安撫羅忠等上其平普安等戰功，重賂劉瑾，得之。

translations.literal: Bin was crafty and overbearing, would not accept control by the two commissions, induced Pacification Assistant Commissioners Luo Zhong and others to memorialize his merit in pacifying Pu'an and other places, heavily bribed Liu Jin, and obtained the post.
translations.idiomatic: Bin was crafty and overbearing and would not accept control by the provincial commissions. He induced Pacification Assistant Commissioners Luo Zhong and others to memorialize his merit in pacifying Pu'an and other places, bribed Liu Jin heavily, and obtained the post.

sentences.zh: 逾年，巡按御史俞緇言不宜授，乃裁之，仍原職。

translations.literal: The next year Investigating Censor Yu Zi said the appointment was inappropriate; it was then revoked and he retained his former office.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Investigating Censor Yu Zi argued that the appointment was inappropriate. It was revoked and Bin retained his former office.

sentences.zh: 初，友既編置保寧，愛益恣，厚斂以賄中貴，征取友向所居凱裏地者獨苛。

translations.literal: Earlier, after You had been assigned to Baoning, Ai grew ever more unrestrained, levied heavily to bribe palace eunuchs, and was especially harsh in collecting the Kaili lands You had formerly held.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, after You had been assigned to Baoning, Ai grew ever more unrestrained. He levied heavily to bribe palace eunuchs and was especially harsh in collecting the Kaili lands You had formerly held.

sentences.zh: 同知楊才居安寧，乘之，朘剝尤甚，諸苗憤怨。

translations.literal: Vice Commissioner Yang Cai dwelt at Anning and took advantage of this, stripping and exploiting all the more; the various Miao grew angry and resentful.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commissioner Yang Cai dwelt at Anning and took advantage of the situation, stripping and exploiting the people all the more. The various Miao tribes grew angry and resentful.

sentences.zh: 凱裏民為友奏復官，弗得，乃潛入保寧，以友還，糾眾作亂，攻播州，焚愛居第及公私廨宇略盡，遂殺才，多所殘戮。

translations.literal: The people of Kaili memorialized for You to be restored to office but failed; they then secretly entered Baoning and brought You back, gathered a crowd to rebel, attacked Bozhou, burned Ai's residence and nearly all public and private offices, then killed Cai and slaughtered many.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Kaili petitioned for You to be restored to office but failed. They then secretly entered Baoning and brought You back, gathered a crowd in revolt, attacked Bozhou, burned Ai's residence and nearly all public and private offices, killed Cai, and slaughtered many others.

sentences.zh: 愛屢奏於朝，帝命鎮巡官調兵征之。

translations.literal: Ai repeatedly memorialized the court; the Emperor ordered frontier officials to mobilize troops to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: Ai repeatedly memorialized the court. The Emperor ordered frontier officials to mobilize troops against them.

sentences.zh: 會友死，遂緩師。

translations.literal: When You died the campaign was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: When You died, the campaign was suspended.

sentences.zh: 已而鎮巡官言：「友子弘能悔過自新，且善撫馭，蠻眾願聽其約束。

translations.literal: Thereafter frontier officials said: "You's son Hong can repent and reform, and moreover governs well; the barbarian masses are willing to accept his restraint."
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter frontier officials reported: "You's son Hong can repent and reform, and governs well. The tribal peoples are willing to accept his authority."

sentences.zh: 其前為友所焚殺者，俱已隨土俗折償，且還所侵奪於官。

translations.literal: Those earlier burned and killed by You have all been compensated according to native custom, and what was seized has been returned to the authorities.
translations.idiomatic: Those earlier burned and killed in You's revolt have all been compensated according to native custom, and seized property has been returned to the authorities.

sentences.zh: 乞授弘冠帶為土舍，協同播州經歷司撫輯諸蠻。

translations.literal: I beg that Hong be granted robes and belt as native steward to assist the Bozhou Registrar's Office in pacifying the various barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that Hong be granted robes and belt as native steward to assist the Bozhou Registrar's Office in pacifying the tribes.

sentences.zh: 其家眾置保寧者仍歸之，隸播州管轄。

translations.literal: His household and followers placed at Baoning should still return to him under Bozhou jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: His household and followers placed at Baoning should return to him under Bozhou jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 並諭斌與弘協和，不得再造釁端。

translations.literal: Bin and Hong should also be instructed to live in harmony and not create trouble again.
translations.idiomatic: Bin and Hong should also be instructed to live in harmony and not create trouble again.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: The reply approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 未幾，播州安撫宋淮奏：「貴州凱口爛土苗婚於凱裏草塘諸寨，陰相構結，誘出苗為亂。

translations.literal: Before long Bozhou Pacification Assistant Commissioner Song Huai memorialized: "The Miao of Guizhou Kaikou and Lantu have married into the stockades of Kaili and Caotang, secretly join in conspiracy, and lure Miao out to rebel."
translations.idiomatic: Before long Bozhou Pacification Assistant Commissioner Song Huai memorialized: "The Miao of Guizhou's Kaikou and Lantu have married into the stockades of Kaili and Caotang, secretly conspire together, and lure tribesmen out to rebel."

sentences.zh: 乞賜斌敕，令每年巡視邊境，會湖廣鎮巡官撫處。

translations.literal: I beg that an edict be granted to Bin ordering him each year to inspect the border and meet Huguang frontier officials to pacify matters.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that an edict be granted to Bin ordering him to inspect the frontier each year and meet with Huguang frontier officials to pacify matters.

sentences.zh: 」部議，土官向無領敕出巡者。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated that native officials had never before been granted edicts to go out on inspection.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated that native officials had never before been granted edicts to go out on inspection tours.

sentences.zh: 諭斌宜撫綏土眾，輯睦親族，以副朝廷優待之意。

translations.literal: Bin was instructed to pacify and settle the native masses and keep kin harmonious, in keeping with the court's favor.
translations.idiomatic: Bin was instructed to pacify the native peoples and keep his kin harmonious, in keeping with the court's favor.

sentences.zh: 因授致仕宣慰愛為昭毅將軍，給誥命，賜麒麟服。

translations.literal: Thereupon the retired Pacification Commissioner Ai was appointed General of Manifest Valor, given patent of appointment, and granted kylin robes.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the retired Pacification Commissioner Ai was appointed General of Manifest Valor, given a patent of appointment, and granted kylin-pattern robes.

sentences.zh: 時斌又為其父請進階及服色，禮科駁之，以服色等威所系，不可假。

translations.literal: At the time Bin also requested advancement in rank and insignia for his father; the Rites Section rejected this, holding that robes and insignia bear on authority and cannot be lent.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Bin also requested advancement in rank and insignia for his father. The Rites Section rejected this, holding that robes and insignia bear on authority and cannot be granted casually.

sentences.zh: 兵部以愛舊有剿賊功，皆許之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War, because Ai had old merit in suppressing bandits, approved all.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War, citing Ai's earlier merit in suppressing rebels, approved all the requests.

sentences.zh: 斌復為其子相請入學，並得賜冠帶。

translations.literal: Bin again requested schooling for his son Xiang, and he too was granted robes and belt.
translations.idiomatic: Bin again asked that his son Xiang enter the Imperial Academy, and he too was granted robes and belt.

sentences.zh: 十二年，播州安撫羅忠、宋淮等奏：「斌有父喪，欲援文臣例守制，但邊防為重，乞仍令掌印理事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Bozhou Pacification Assistant Commissioners Luo Zhong, Song Huai, and others memorialized: "Bin has a father's mourning and wishes to follow the civil officials' rule of observing mourning, but the frontier defense is weighty; I beg that he still be allowed to hold the seal and manage affairs."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Bozhou Pacification Assistant Commissioners Luo Zhong, Song Huai, and others memorialized: "Bin is in mourning for his father and wishes to follow the civil officials' rule of observing mourning, but frontier defense is paramount. I beg that he still be allowed to hold the seal and manage affairs."

sentences.zh: 」初，楊弘既歸凱裏，與重安土舍馮綸等有怨。

translations.literal: Earlier, after Yang Hong had returned to Kaili, he had enmity with Chong'an native steward Feng Lun and others.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, after Yang Hong had returned to Kaili, he had fallen out with Chong'an native steward Feng Lun and others.

sentences.zh: 弘卒，綸等誘苗蠻攻之，更相仇殺，侵軼貴州境。

translations.literal: When Hong died, Lun and others induced Miao and barbarians to attack; they killed one another in turn and raided into Guizhou territory.
translations.idiomatic: When Hong died, Lun and others induced Miao tribes to attack. They killed one another in turn and raided into Guizhou territory.

sentences.zh: 巡撫鄒文盛言狀，且請移文四川，會官撫處，逾歲不報。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Zou Wensheng reported the situation and also asked that a dispatch be sent to Sichuan for officials to meet and pacify matters; for more than a year there was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Zou Wensheng reported the situation and asked that a dispatch be sent to Sichuan for officials to meet and pacify matters. For more than a year there was no reply.

sentences.zh: 文盛乃遣參議蔡潮入播州，督致仕楊斌撫平之。

translations.literal: Wensheng then sent Participant Secretary Cai Chao into Bozhou to supervise the retired Yang Bin in pacifying the disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: Wensheng then sent Participant Secretary Cai Chao into Bozhou to supervise the retired Yang Bin in pacifying the disturbance.

sentences.zh: 因言：「宜復安寧宣撫，俾弘子弟襲之。

translations.literal: He therefore said: "Anning Pacification Assistant Commission should be restored and Hong's sons and younger brothers allowed to inherit it."
translations.idiomatic: He therefore proposed: "The Anning Pacification Assistant Commission should be restored and Hong's sons and younger brothers allowed to inherit it."

sentences.zh: 斌未衰，宜仍起任事，以制諸蠻寨。

translations.literal: Bin is not yet decrepit and should still be recalled to manage affairs so as to control the various barbarian stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Bin is not yet infirm and should be recalled to office to control the various tribal stockades.

sentences.zh: 潮有撫蠻勞，宜量擢。

translations.literal: Chao has merit in pacifying the barbarians and should be promoted in measure.
translations.idiomatic: Chao has merit in pacifying the tribes and should receive a measured promotion.

sentences.zh: 」兵部議：「安寧已革不可復，斌子既代，亦不可起。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War deliberated: "Anning has already been abolished and cannot be restored; Bin's son has already succeeded and Bin likewise cannot be recalled."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War replied: "Anning has already been abolished and cannot be restored. Bin's son has already succeeded, and Bin likewise cannot be recalled."

sentences.zh: 土官應襲與否，屬四川，非黔所得專。

translations.literal: Whether native officials should inherit falls under Sichuan; Guizhou cannot decide alone.
translations.idiomatic: Whether native officials should inherit is a matter for Sichuan, not something Guizhou may decide on its own.

sentences.zh: 盛所請難行，而功不可誣。

translations.literal: What Sheng requested is hard to carry out, yet his merit cannot be denied.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng's requests could not be granted, but his merit could not be denied.

sentences.zh: 」十六年賜斌蟒衣玉帶。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Bin was granted python robes and jade belt.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Bin was granted python-pattern robes and a jade belt.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年賜播州儒學《四書集註》，從宣慰楊相奏也。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiajing the Bozhou Confucian school was granted the Collected Commentaries on the Four Books, following Pacification Commissioner Yang Xiang's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiajing the Bozhou Confucian school was granted Zhu Xi's Collected Commentaries on the Four Books, at Pacification Commissioner Yang Xiang's request.

sentences.zh: 弘既死，其弟張求襲職不得，時盜邊，劫白泥司印信，復與相構兵。

translations.literal: After Hong died, his younger brother Zhang sought to inherit the office but failed; he then raided the border, seized the seals of Baini Commission, and again made war on Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: After Hong died, his younger brother Zhang sought to inherit the office but failed. He then raided the frontier, seized the seals of the Baini Commission, and again made war on Xiang.

sentences.zh: 守臣乞改凱裏屬貴州，以張為土知州解釋之。

translations.literal: Frontier officials begged to transfer Kaili to Guizhou jurisdiction and appoint Zhang native prefect to settle the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials asked that Kaili be transferred to Guizhou and that Zhang be appointed native prefect to settle the matter.

sentences.zh: 兵部議：「張習父兄之惡，幸免於辜；

translations.literal: The Ministry of War deliberated: "Zhang has learned his father and elder brother's wickedness and narrowly escaped punishment;"
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War replied: "Zhang has learned his father and elder brother's wickedness and narrowly escaped punishment."

sentences.zh: 敢肆然執印信以要挾，當命川、貴守臣按其前後爭產殺人諸罪，置於理。

translations.literal: yet he dares openly seize seals to extort; Sichuan and Guizhou frontier officials should be ordered to investigate his crimes of disputing property and killing people before and after, and bring him to justice.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he dares openly seize seals to extort the court. Sichuan and Guizhou frontier officials should be ordered to investigate his crimes of property disputes and murder and bring him to justice.

sentences.zh: 若張悔過輸情，還所獲印，尚可量授一官，聽調殺賊以自效。

translations.literal: If Zhang repents and submits sincerely, returns the seized seals, he may still be granted an office in measure and allowed to be mobilized to kill bandits and prove his merit.
translations.idiomatic: If Zhang repents sincerely and returns the seized seals, he may still be granted a modest office and allowed to prove himself by campaigning against rebels.

sentences.zh: 倘或怙終，必誅以為玩法戒。

translations.literal: If he persists to the end, he must be executed as a warning against defying the law.
translations.idiomatic: If he persists, he must be executed as a warning against defying the law.

sentences.zh: 」既，遂許張襲宣撫，而改安寧為凱裏，隸貴川。

translations.literal: Thereafter Zhang was allowed to inherit the Pacification Assistant Commission, Anning was changed to Kaili, and it was placed under Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Zhang was allowed to inherit the Pacification Assistant Commission, Anning was redesignated Kaili, and it was placed under Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 初，楊相之祖父皆以嫡庶相爭，梯禍數世。

translations.literal: Earlier, Xiang's grandfather and father had all contended as legitimate and illegitimate heirs, piling calamity for generations.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Xiang's grandfather and father had all fought over succession between legitimate and illegitimate lines, piling calamity on the family for generations.

sentences.zh: 至是，相復寵庶子煦。

translations.literal: At this time Xiang again favored his son by a concubine, Xu.
translations.idiomatic: By then Xiang again favored his son by a concubine, Xu.

sentences.zh: 嫡子烈母張，悍甚，與烈盜兵逐相，相走，客死水西。

translations.literal: The principal wife of the legitimate son Lie, née Zhang, was fierce; she and Lie stole troops to drive Xiang out; Xiang fled and died as a guest in Shuixi.
translations.idiomatic: The principal wife of the legitimate son Lie, née Zhang, was fierce. She and Lie raised troops to drive Xiang out. Xiang fled and died as a guest in Shuixi.

sentences.zh: 烈求父屍，宣慰安萬銓因要挾水煙、天旺故地，而後予屍，烈陽許之。

translations.literal: Lie sought his father's corpse; Pacification Assistant Commissioner An Wanquan used this to extort the former lands of Shuiyan and Tianwang, and only then gave the corpse; Lie pretended to agree.
translations.idiomatic: Lie sought his father's body. Pacification Assistant Commissioner An Wanquan used this to extort the former lands of Shuiyan and Tianwang and only then surrendered the corpse. Lie pretended to agree.

sentences.zh: 及相喪還，烈靳地不予，遂與水西構難，又殺其長官王黻。

translations.literal: When Xiang's funeral returned, Lie withheld the land and would not give it; he then made trouble with Shuixi and also killed Native Official Wang Fu.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiang's funeral procession returned, Lie withheld the land. He then fell out with Shuixi and killed Native Official Wang Fu.

sentences.zh: 時嘉靖二十三年也。

translations.literal: This was in the twenty-third year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: This was in the twenty-third year of Jiajing.

sentences.zh: 烈既代襲，遂與黻黨李保治兵相攻，垂十年，總督馮嶽調總兵石邦憲討平之。

translations.literal: After Lie inherited the office, he and Fu's follower Li Bao raised troops and attacked one another for nearly ten years; Grand Coordinator Feng Yue mobilized Grand Commander Shi Bangxian to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: After Lie inherited the office, he and Fu's follower Li Bao raised troops against each other for nearly ten years. Grand Coordinator Feng Yue mobilized Grand Commander Shi Bangxian to put down the disturbance.

sentences.zh: 真州苗盧阿項者亦久稱亂，邦憲以兵七千擊敗之。

translations.literal: The Zhenzhou Miao Lu Axiang had also long been in rebellion; Bangxian with seven thousand troops defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhenzhou Miao leader Lu Axiang had also long been in rebellion. Bangxian defeated him with seven thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 有言賊求援於播者，邦憲曰：「吾方調水西兵，聲揚烈助逆罪，烈暇救人乎。

translations.literal: Some said the bandits sought aid from Bozhou; Bangxian said: "I am just now mobilizing Shuixi troops and will proclaim Lie's crime of aiding rebels—would Lie have leisure to save others?"
translations.idiomatic: Some said the rebels sought aid from Bozhou. Bangxian said: "I am mobilizing Shuixi troops and will proclaim Lie's crime of aiding rebels. Would Lie have leisure to save anyone else?"

sentences.zh: 」已，擒阿項父子，斬獲四百余人。

translations.literal: Thereafter Axiang and his son were captured; more than four hundred were killed or taken.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Axiang and his son were captured, and more than four hundred were killed or taken.

sentences.zh: 初，嘉靖初，議分凱裏屬貴州，既，又以播地多在貴州境，並改屬思石兵備。

translations.literal: Earlier, at the beginning of Jiajing, it was proposed to assign Kaili to Guizhou; later, because most Bozhou territory lay within Guizhou, it was also transferred to the Sishi military circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jiajing it was proposed to assign Kaili to Guizhou. Later, because most Bozhou territory lay within Guizhou, it was also placed under the Sishi military circuit.

sentences.zh: 及真州盜平，地方安靖，播人以為非便。

translations.literal: When the Zhenzhou bandits were pacified and the region grew calm, the people of Bozhou thought this inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhenzhou rebels were pacified and the region grew calm, the people of Bozhou found the arrangement inconvenient.

sentences.zh: 川、貴守臣異議不決，命總督會勘。

translations.literal: Sichuan and Guizhou frontier officials disagreed and no decision was reached; the grand coordinator was ordered to investigate jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan and Guizhou frontier officials disagreed and no decision was reached. The grand coordinator was ordered to investigate jointly.

sentences.zh: 總督奏，仍以播歸四川，而貴州思石兵備仍兼制播、酉、平、邑諸土司事，報可。

translations.literal: The grand coordinator memorialized that Bozhou should still return to Sichuan, while Guizhou's Sishi military circuit should still jointly control the tribal domains of Bo, You, Ping, and Yi; the reply approved.
translations.idiomatic: The grand coordinator memorialized that Bozhou should return to Sichuan, while Guizhou's Sishi military circuit should still oversee the tribal domains of Bo, You, Ping, and Yi. The court approved.

sentences.zh: 隆慶五年，烈死，子應龍請襲，命予職。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Longqing, Lie died; his son Yinglong requested inheritance and was ordered given the office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Longqing, Lie died. His son Yinglong requested inheritance and was granted the office.

sentences.zh: 萬歷元年給應龍宣慰使敕書。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wanli, Yinglong was given the patent of Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wanli, Yinglong was granted the patent of Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八年賜故宣慰楊烈祭葬，從應龍請也。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the former Pacification Commissioner Yang Lie was granted funeral rites, at Yinglong's request.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the former Pacification Commissioner Yang Lie was granted state funeral rites, at Yinglong's request.

sentences.zh: 十四年，應龍獻大木七十，材美，賜飛魚服，又復引其祖斌賜蟒例。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Yinglong presented seventy great timbers of fine quality and was granted flying-fish robes; he again cited the precedent of his grandfather Bin receiving python robes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Yinglong presented seventy great timbers of fine quality and was granted flying-fish-pattern robes. He again cited the precedent of his grandfather Bin receiving python robes.

sentences.zh: 部議，以斌有軍功，且出特恩，未可為比。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated that because Bin had military merit and it had been a special grace, it could not be taken as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry held that because Bin's grant had been for military merit and was a special grace, it could not serve as precedent.

sentences.zh: 帝命以都指揮使銜授應龍。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Yinglong granted the rank of regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Yinglong granted the rank of regional commander.

sentences.zh: 十八年，貴州巡撫葉夢熊疏論應龍兇惡諸事，巡按陳效歷數應龍二十四大罪。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Guizhou Grand Coordinator Ye Mengxiong memorialized on Yinglong's vicious deeds; Investigating Censor Chen Xiao enumerated Yinglong's twenty-four great crimes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Guizhou Grand Coordinator Ye Mengxiong memorialized on Yinglong's vicious conduct. Investigating Censor Chen Xiao enumerated twenty-four major charges against him.

sentences.zh: 時方防禦松潘，調播州土兵協守，四川巡按李化龍疏請暫免勘問，俾應龍戴罪圖功。

translations.literal: At the time they were defending Songpan; Bozhou native troops were mobilized to assist in garrison; Sichuan Investigating Censor Li Hualong memorialized asking temporarily to suspend investigation and let Yinglong perform merit while bearing guilt.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the frontier was defending Songpan and Bozhou native troops were mobilized to assist. Sichuan Investigating Censor Li Hualong asked that the investigation be suspended temporarily so Yinglong might perform merit while bearing guilt.

sentences.zh: 由是，川、貴撫按疏辨，在蜀者謂應龍無可勘之罪，在黔者謂蜀有私匿應龍之心。

translations.literal: Thereupon Sichuan and Guizhou grand coordinators and censors memorialized in dispute; those in Shu said Yinglong had no crimes worth investigating, those in Qian said Shu harbored a private wish to shield Yinglong.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Sichuan and Guizhou officials memorialized in dispute. Those in Shu said Yinglong had committed no crime worth investigating. Those in Qian said Shu wished privately to shield him.

sentences.zh: 於是給事中張希臯等，以事屬重大，兩省利害，豈漫不相關者，乞從公會勘，無執成心。

translations.literal: Thereupon Supervising Secretary Zhang Xigao and others, because the matter was grave and the interests of the two provinces could hardly be unrelated, begged a fair joint investigation without fixed prejudice.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Zhang Xigao and others then argued that the matter was grave and the interests of the two provinces closely linked. They asked for a fair joint investigation without fixed prejudice.

sentences.zh: 十九年，夢熊主議，播州所轄五司改土為流，悉屬重慶，與化龍意復相左。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Mengxiong led deliberation to change the five commissions under Bozhou from native to regular administration, all subordinate to Chongqing, again contrary to Hualong's view.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year Mengxiong led deliberation to convert the five commissions under Bozhou from native to regular administration, all subordinate to Chongqing, again contrary to Hualong's view.

sentences.zh: 化龍遂引嫌求斥。

translations.literal: Hualong then cited conflict of interest and asked to be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Hualong then cited conflict of interest and asked to be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 蓋應龍本雄猜，阻兵嗜殺，所轄五司七姓悉叛離。

translations.literal: For Yinglong was by nature fierce and suspicious, kept troops and loved killing; the five commissions and seven clans under him all rebelled and left.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong was by nature fierce and suspicious, kept troops and loved killing, and the five commissions and seven clans under him all rebelled and left him.

sentences.zh: 嬖妾田屠妻張氏，並及其母。

translations.literal: His favorite concubine Tian slaughtered his wife, née Zhang, and also his mother.
translations.idiomatic: His favorite concubine Tian murdered his wife, née Zhang, and his mother as well.

sentences.zh: 妻叔張時照與所部何恩、宋世臣等上變，告應龍反。

translations.literal: His wife's uncle Zhang Shizhao, together with He En, Song Shichen, and others of his following, submitted an urgent report accusing Yinglong of rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: His wife's uncle Zhang Shizhao, together with He En, Song Shichen, and others of his following, submitted an urgent report accusing Yinglong of rebellion.

sentences.zh: 夢熊請發兵剿之，蜀中士大夫悉謂蜀三面鄰播，屬裔以什伯數，皆其彈壓，且兵驍勇，數征調有功，剪除未為長策。

translations.literal: Mengxiong asked to send troops to suppress him; the gentry of Shu all said Shu on three sides borders Bozhou, with dependent tribes in the tens and hundreds all under its pressure, and moreover its troops are fierce and brave and have repeatedly performed merit when mobilized; to cut them down is not a long-term plan.
translations.idiomatic: Mengxiong asked to send troops to suppress him. The gentry of Shu argued that Shu bordered Bozhou on three sides, with dependent tribes numbering in the tens and hundreds all under its control. Its troops were fierce and had repeatedly performed well when mobilized. To destroy it was not a sound long-term plan.

sentences.zh: 以故，蜀撫按並主撫。

translations.literal: For this reason Sichuan grand coordinators and censors all favored pacification.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason Sichuan grand coordinators and censors all favored pacification.

sentences.zh: 朝議命勘，應龍願赴蜀，不赴黔。

translations.literal: Court deliberation ordered investigation; Yinglong was willing to go to Shu but not to Qian.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered an investigation. Yinglong was willing to go to Shu but not to Qian.

sentences.zh: 二十年，應龍詣重慶對簿，坐法當斬，請以二萬金贖。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Yinglong came to Chongqing for trial; by law he deserved execution and asked to ransom himself with twenty thousand taels of gold.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Yinglong came to Chongqing for trial. By law he deserved execution and offered twenty thousand taels of gold to ransom himself.

sentences.zh: 御史張鶴鳴方駁問，會倭大入朝鮮，征天下兵，應龍因奏辨，且願將五千兵征倭自贖，詔釋之。

translations.literal: Censor Zhang Heming was just cross-examining him when the Japanese greatly invaded Korea and troops were mobilized empire-wide; Yinglong thereupon memorialized in defense and also offered to lead five thousand troops against Japan to redeem himself; an edict released him.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhang Heming was cross-examining him when the Japanese invaded Korea in force and troops were mobilized empire-wide. Yinglong memorialized in his defense and offered to lead five thousand troops against Japan to redeem himself. An edict released him.

sentences.zh: 兵已啟行，尋報罷。

translations.literal: The troops had already set out when word soon came to halt.
translations.idiomatic: The troops had already set out when orders soon came to halt the campaign.

sentences.zh: 巡撫王繼光至，嚴提勘結，應龍抗不出。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Wang Jiguang arrived and strictly demanded the investigation be concluded; Yinglong resisted and would not come out.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Wang Jiguang arrived and strictly demanded that the investigation be concluded. Yinglong resisted and would not appear.

sentences.zh: 張時照等復詣奏闕下，繼光用兵之議遂決。

translations.literal: Zhang Shizhao and others again went to memorialize at court; Jiguang's proposal to use troops was then decided.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shizhao and others again memorialized at court, and Jiguang's proposal to use troops was approved.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，繼光至重慶，與總兵劉承嗣等分兵三道進婁山關，屯白石口。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Jiguang reached Chongqing and, with Grand Commander Liu Chengsi and others, divided troops into three routes advancing on Loushan Pass and encamped at Baishikou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Jiguang reached Chongqing and, with Grand Commander Liu Chengsi and others, divided troops into three columns advancing on Loushan Pass and encamped at Baishikou.

sentences.zh: 應龍佯約降，而統苗兵據關沖擊。

translations.literal: Yinglong feigned agreement to surrender but gathered Miao troops to hold the pass and charge.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong feigned agreement to surrender but gathered Miao troops to hold the pass and attack.

sentences.zh: 承嗣兵敗，殺傷大半。

translations.literal: Chengsi's army was defeated and more than half were killed or wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Chengsi's army was defeated and more than half were killed or wounded.

sentences.zh: 會繼光論罷，即撤兵，委棄輜重略盡。

translations.literal: When Jiguang was dismissed from office through censure, troops were at once withdrawn and baggage was abandoned nearly entirely.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiguang was dismissed through censure, the army was at once withdrawn and nearly all baggage was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 黔師協剿，亦無功。

translations.literal: Guizhou troops assisting the campaign also achieved nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou troops assisting the campaign also achieved nothing.

sentences.zh: 時四川新撫譚希忠與貴州鎮、撫再議剿，御史薛繼茂主撫。

translations.literal: At the time the new Sichuan grand coordinator Tan Xizhong and Guizhou commanders and coordinators again deliberated suppression; Censor Xue Jimao favored pacification.
translations.idiomatic: The new Sichuan grand coordinator Tan Xizhong and Guizhou commanders and coordinators again deliberated suppression. Censor Xue Jimao favored pacification.

sentences.zh: 應龍上書自白，遣其黨攜金入京行間，執原奏何恩詣綦江縣。

translations.literal: Yinglong memorialized in his own defense, sent his followers with gold to the capital to bribe officials, and seized the original accuser He En and brought him to Qijiang County.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong memorialized in his own defense, sent followers with gold to the capital to bribe officials, and seized the original accuser He En and brought him to Qijiang County.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，以兵部侍郎刑玠總督貴州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year Vice Minister of War Xing Jie was made grand coordinator of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year Vice Minister of War Xing Jie was appointed grand coordinator of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，玠至蜀，察永寧、酉陽皆應龍姻媾，而黃平、白泥久為仇仇，宜剪其枝黨。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Jie reached Shu, observed that Yongning and Youyang were all Yinglong's affines, while Huangping and Baini had long been bitter enemies, and that his branch allies should be cut off.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Jie reached Shu and observed that Yongning and Youyang were allied to Yinglong by marriage, while Huangping and Baini had long been his bitter enemies. He decided to cut off Yinglong's branch allies.

sentences.zh: 乃檄應龍，謂當待以不死。

translations.literal: He then sent a dispatch to Yinglong saying he would be treated as not deserving death.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent a dispatch to Yinglong saying his life would be spared.

sentences.zh: 會水西宣慰安疆臣請父國亨恤典，兵部尚書石星手劄示疆臣，趣應龍就吏得貰，疆臣奉劄至播招應龍。

translations.literal: It happened that Shuixi Pacification Commissioner An Jiangchen requested funeral honors for his father Guoheng; Minister of War Shi Xing sent a personal note to Jiangchen urging that if Yinglong submitted to judgment he could be ransomed; Jiangchen brought the note to Bozhou to summon Yinglong.
translations.idiomatic: Shuixi Pacification Commissioner An Jiangchen had requested funeral honors for his father Guoheng. Minister of War Shi Xing sent Jiangchen a personal note urging that if Yinglong submitted to judgment he could be ransomed. Jiangchen brought the note to Bozhou to summon Yinglong.

sentences.zh: 時七姓恐應龍出得除罪，而四方亡命竄匿其間，又幸龍反，因以為利，驛傳文移，輒從中阻。

translations.literal: At the time the seven clans feared that if Yinglong came out he would be cleared of guilt; meanwhile fugitives from all directions hid among them and also hoped Yinglong would rebel, profiting thereby; relay dispatches were repeatedly blocked midway.
translations.idiomatic: The seven clans feared that if Yinglong submitted he would be cleared. Fugitives from all directions hid among them and hoped he would rebel, profiting from the chaos. Relay dispatches were repeatedly intercepted.

sentences.zh: 玠檄重慶知府王士琦詣綦江，趣應龍安穩聽勘。

translations.literal: Jie dispatched Chongqing Prefect Wang Shiqi to Qijiang to urge Yinglong to come peacefully to Anwen and submit to investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Jie dispatched Chongqing Prefect Wang Shiqi to Qijiang to urge Yinglong to come peacefully to Anwen and submit to investigation.

sentences.zh: 應龍使弟兆龍至安穩，治郵舍，儲糒叩頭郊迎，致餼牽如禮，言：「應龍縛渠魁，待罪松坎。

translations.literal: Yinglong sent his younger brother Zhaolong to Anwen to prepare relay lodges, store grain, kowtow in suburban welcome, and present gifts according to ritual, saying: "Yinglong has bound the ringleaders and awaits judgment at Songkan."
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong sent his younger brother Zhaolong to Anwen to prepare relay lodges, store grain, kowtow in welcome at the suburbs, and present gifts according to ritual, saying: "Yinglong has bound the ringleaders and awaits judgment at Songkan."

sentences.zh: 所不敢至安穩者，恐墮安穩仇民不測禍也，幸請至松坎受事。

translations.literal: What he dares not come to Anwen for is fear of falling into unforeseen harm from Anwen's hostile people; he begs to be allowed to submit at Songkan.
translations.idiomatic: He dares not come to Anwen for fear of harm from hostile locals there. He begs to be allowed to submit at Songkan.

sentences.zh: 」士琦曰，「松坎亦曩奏勘地。

translations.literal: Shiqi said, "Songkan is also ground long reported for investigation."
translations.idiomatic: Shiqi said, "Songkan is also territory long designated for investigation."

sentences.zh: 」即單騎往。

translations.literal: He at once went alone on horseback.
translations.idiomatic: He at once rode there alone.

sentences.zh: 應龍果面縛道旁，泣請死罪，願執罪人，獻罰金，得自比安國亨。

translations.literal: Yinglong indeed bound himself facing the road, wept and begged for death, offered to hand over the guilty, present a fine, and be treated like An Guoheng.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong had indeed bound himself by the roadside. Weeping, he begged for death, offered to hand over the guilty, pay a fine, and be treated like An Guoheng.

sentences.zh: 國亨者，曩亦被訐懼罪不出界，故應龍引之。

translations.literal: Guoheng had also once been accused, feared guilt, and would not leave his border; therefore Yinglong cited him.
translations.idiomatic: Guoheng had also once been accused, feared punishment, and would not leave his border. Yinglong cited him for that reason.

sentences.zh: 士琦為請於玠，許之，應龍乃縛獻黃元等十二人。

translations.literal: Shiqi pleaded with Jie, who approved; Yinglong then bound and presented Huang Yuan and twelve others.
translations.idiomatic: Shiqi pleaded with Jie, who approved. Yinglong then bound and presented Huang Yuan and twelve others.

sentences.zh: 案驗，抵應龍斬，論贖，輸四萬金助采木，仍革職，以子朝棟代，次子可棟羈府追贖，黃元等斬重慶市，總督以聞。

translations.literal: On examination Yinglong merited execution; he was ransomed, paid forty thousand taels of gold to assist timber procurement, was still dismissed from office with his son Chaodong succeeding, second son Kedong detained in the prefecture to pursue ransom; Huang Yuan and others were beheaded in Chongqing market; the grand coordinator reported upward.
translations.idiomatic: On examination Yinglong merited execution. He was ransomed, paid forty thousand taels of gold to assist timber procurement, and was dismissed from office. His son Chaodong succeeded him, while his second son Kedong was detained in the prefecture until ransom was paid. Huang Yuan and others were beheaded in the Chongqing market. The grand coordinator reported upward.

sentences.zh: 時倭氛未靖，兵部欲緩應龍，事東方，朝廷亦以應龍向有積勞，可其奏，於松坎設同知治焉，以士琦為川東兵備副使彈治之。

translations.literal: At the time the Japanese threat was not yet settled; the Ministry of War wished to ease matters with Yinglong and attend to the east; the court also, because Yinglong had long-standing accumulated merit, approved the memorial; an assistant prefect was established at Songkan to govern there, with Shiqi made eastern Sichuan military vice commissioner to restrain him.
translations.idiomatic: The Japanese threat was not yet settled. The Ministry of War wished to ease matters with Yinglong and attend to the east. The court also approved, citing Yinglong's long service. An assistant prefect was established at Songkan to govern the area, with Shiqi made eastern Sichuan military vice commissioner to restrain him.

sentences.zh: 應龍獲寬，益怙終不悛。

translations.literal: Yinglong obtained leniency and grew all the more obstinate and unrepentant.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong obtained leniency and grew all the more obstinate and unrepentant.

sentences.zh: 尋可棟死於重慶，益痛恨。

translations.literal: Soon Kedong died in Chongqing and he hated all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Kedong died in Chongqing, and his hatred deepened.

sentences.zh: 促喪歸不得，復檄完贖，大言曰：「吾子活，銀即至矣。

translations.literal: He was urged to return the coffin but could not; a dispatch again demanded completion of ransom; he said loudly: "If my son lives, the silver will come at once."
translations.idiomatic: He was urged to return the body but could not. A dispatch again demanded completion of the ransom. He declared loudly: "If my son lives, the silver will come at once."

sentences.zh: 」擁兵驅千余僧招魂去。

translations.literal: He led troops and drove more than a thousand monks to conduct the soul away.
translations.idiomatic: He led troops and drove more than a thousand monks away to conduct the funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 分遣土目，署關據險。

translations.literal: He dispatched native headmen in divisions to garrison passes and hold strategic points.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched native headmen to garrison passes and hold strategic points.

sentences.zh: 厚撫諸苗，名其健者為硬手；

translations.literal: He treated the various Miao generously and named the strong among them "hard hands";
translations.idiomatic: He treated the various Miao generously and named the strongest among them "hard hands."

sentences.zh: 州人稍殷厚者，沒入其貲以養苗。

translations.literal: those among the prefecture people who were somewhat wealthy had their property confiscated to support the Miao.
translations.idiomatic: Those among the prefecture people who were somewhat wealthy had their property confiscated to support the Miao.

sentences.zh: 苗人鹹願為出死力。

translations.literal: The Miao all were willing to exert themselves to the death.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao were all willing to fight to the death for him.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，應龍殘余慶，掠大阡、都壩，焚劫草塘、余慶二司及興隆、都勻各衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Yinglong ravaged Yuqing, plundered Daqian and Duba, and burned and robbed the two commissions of Caotang and Yuqing and the guards of Xinglong and Duyun.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Yinglong ravaged Yuqing, plundered Daqian and Duba, and burned and looted the Caotang and Yuqing commissions and the guards of Xinglong and Duyun.

sentences.zh: 又遣其黨圍黃平，戮重安長官家，勢復大熾。

translations.literal: He again sent his followers to besiege Huangping and slaughter the family of the Chong'an native official; his power flared up once more.
translations.idiomatic: He again sent his followers to besiege Huangping and slaughter the family of the Chong'an native official. His power flared up once more.

sentences.zh: 二十五年流劫江津及南川，臨合江，索其仇袁子升，縋城下，磔之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he raided Jiangjin and Nanchuan, approached Hejiang, demanded his enemy Yuan Zisheng, had him lowered from the wall, and dismembered him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he raided Jiangjin and Nanchuan, approached Hejiang, demanded his enemy Yuan Zisheng, had him lowered from the wall, and dismembered him.

sentences.zh: 時兵備王士琦調征倭，應龍益統苗兵，大掠貴州洪頭、高坪、新村諸屯。

translations.literal: At the time Military Vice Commissioner Wang Shiqi was mobilized against Japan; Yinglong all the more gathered Miao troops and greatly plundered the colonies of Hongtou, Gaoping, Xincun, and others in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Military Vice Commissioner Wang Shiqi had been mobilized against Japan. Yinglong gathered Miao troops and greatly plundered the colonies of Hongtou, Gaoping, Xincun, and others in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 已，又侵湖廣四十八屯，阻塞驛站。

translations.literal: Thereafter he again invaded Huguang's forty-eight colonies and blocked relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he invaded Huguang's forty-eight colonies and blocked the relay stations.

sentences.zh: 诇原奏仇民宋世臣、羅承恩等挈家匿偏橋衛，襲破之。

translations.literal: He learned that his original accusers Song Shichen, Luo Chengen, and others had brought their families to hide in Pianqiao Guard; he attacked and broke it.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that his original accusers Song Shichen, Luo Chengen, and others had brought their families to hide in Pianqiao Guard, he attacked and overran it.

sentences.zh: 大索城中，戮其父母，淫其妻女，備極慘酷。

translations.literal: He searched the city thoroughly, killed their parents, violated their wives and daughters, and was cruel to the utmost.
translations.idiomatic: He searched the city thoroughly, killed their parents, violated their wives and daughters, and was cruel beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，貴州巡撫江東之令都司楊國柱部卒三千剿應龍，奪三百落。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Guizhou Grand Coordinator Jiang Dongzhi ordered Regional Commander Yang Guozhu with three thousand troops to campaign against Yinglong and seize three hundred settlements.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year Guizhou Grand Coordinator Jiang Dongzhi ordered Regional Commander Yang Guozhu with three thousand troops against Yinglong. They seized three hundred settlements.

sentences.zh: 賊佯北，誘師殲焉，國柱等盡死。

translations.literal: The bandits feigned retreat north, lured the army, and destroyed it; Guozhu and the others all died.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels feigned a retreat north, lured the army into an ambush, and destroyed it. Guozhu and the others all died.

sentences.zh: 東之罷，以郭子章代，而起李化龍節制川、湖、貴州諸軍事，調東征諸將劉綎、麻貴、陳璘、董一元南征。

translations.literal: Dongzhi was dismissed and replaced by Guo Zizhang; Li Hualong was raised to direct military affairs of Sichuan, Huguang, and Guizhou, and the eastern campaign generals Liu Ting, Ma Gui, Chen Lin, and Dong Yiyuan were mobilized south.
translations.idiomatic: Dongzhi was dismissed and replaced by Guo Zizhang. Li Hualong was appointed to direct military affairs in Sichuan, Huguang, and Guizhou. The eastern campaign generals Liu Ting, Ma Gui, Chen Lin, and Dong Yiyuan were mobilized for the southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 時應龍乘大兵未集，勒兵犯綦江。

translations.literal: At the time Yinglong, while the great army had not yet assembled, led troops to invade Qijiang.
translations.idiomatic: While the main army had not yet assembled, Yinglong led troops to invade Qijiang.

sentences.zh: 城中新募兵不滿三千，賊兵八萬奄至，遊擊張良賢巷戰死，綦江陷。

translations.literal: In the city the newly recruited troops numbered fewer than three thousand; eighty thousand bandit troops suddenly arrived; Guerrilla Commander Zhang Liangxian died fighting in the lanes; Qijiang fell.
translations.idiomatic: The newly recruited garrison numbered fewer than three thousand. Eighty thousand rebel troops suddenly arrived. Guerrilla Commander Zhang Liangxian died fighting in the streets, and Qijiang fell.

sentences.zh: 應龍盡殺城中人，投屍蔽江，水為赤。

translations.literal: Yinglong killed everyone in the city, cast corpses to cover the river, and the water turned red.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong killed everyone in the city and cast corpses into the river until the water turned red.

sentences.zh: 益結九股生苗及黑腳苗等為助，屯官壩，聲窺蜀。

translations.literal: He further joined the nine-stockade raw Miao and Black-Foot Miao and others as helpers, encamped at Guanba, and proclaimed he would spy into Shu.
translations.idiomatic: He further enlisted the nine-stockade raw Miao, the Black-Foot Miao, and others, encamped at Guanba, and threatened to invade Shu.

sentences.zh: 已，遂焚東坡、爛橋，楚、黔路梗。

translations.literal: Thereafter he burned Dongpo and Lanqiao, and the routes of Chu and Qian were blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he burned Dongpo and Lanqiao, blocking the routes between Huguang and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，應龍五道並出，破龍泉司。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year Yinglong sent out five columns together and broke Longquan Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year Yinglong sent out five columns together and overran Longquan Commission.

sentences.zh: 時總督李化龍已移駐重慶，征兵大集，遂以二月十二月誓師，分八路進。

translations.literal: At the time Grand Coordinator Li Hualong had moved his headquarters to Chongqing; troops were greatly assembled; he then on the twelfth day of the second month took the oath and divided into eight routes to advance.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Li Hualong had moved his headquarters to Chongqing and assembled a great army. On the twelfth day of the second month he took the oath and divided his forces into eight columns to advance.

sentences.zh: 每路約三萬人，官兵三之，土司七之，旗鼓甲仗森列，苗大驚。

translations.literal: Each route had about thirty thousand men, three parts regular troops and seven parts native chieftains; flags, drums, armor, and weapons stood in dense array, and the Miao were greatly alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: Each column had about thirty thousand men, three parts regular troops and seven parts native levies. Flags, drums, armor, and weapons stood in dense array, and the Miao were greatly alarmed.

sentences.zh: 總兵劉綎破其前鋒，楊朝棟僅以身免，賊膽落。

translations.literal: Grand Commander Liu Ting broke their vanguard; Yang Chaodong barely escaped with his life; the bandits' courage collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commander Liu Ting broke their vanguard. Yang Chaodong barely escaped with his life, and the rebels' courage collapsed.

sentences.zh: 遂連克桑木、烏江、河渡三關，奪天都、三百落諸囤。

translations.literal: He then took in succession the three passes of Sangmu, Wujiang, and Hedu, and seized the stockades of Tiandu and Sanbailuo.
translations.idiomatic: He then took in succession the three passes of Sangmu, Wujiang, and Hedu, and seized the stockades of Tiandu and Sanbailuo.

sentences.zh: 賊連敗，乃乘隙突犯烏江，詐稱水西隴澄會哨，誘永順兵，斷橋，淹死將卒無算。

translations.literal: The bandits, repeatedly defeated, then seized an opening to strike suddenly at Wujiang, falsely claiming Shuixi Long Cheng was joining patrol, lured Yongshun troops, cut the bridge, and drowned countless officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: After repeated defeats, the rebels seized an opening to strike at Wujiang. They falsely claimed Shuixi Long Cheng was joining a patrol, lured Yongshun troops onto a bridge, cut it, and drowned countless officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 尋綎破九盤，入婁山關。

translations.literal: Soon Ting broke Jiupan and entered Loushan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Ting broke Jiupan and entered Loushan Pass.

sentences.zh: 關為賊前門，萬峰插天，中通一線。

translations.literal: The pass was the bandits' front gate; ten thousand peaks pierced the sky with only a single thread through the middle.
translations.idiomatic: The pass was the rebels' front gate. Ten thousand peaks pierced the sky, with only a narrow thread of passage through the center.

sentences.zh: 綎從間道攀藤毀柵入，陷焉。

translations.literal: Ting by a hidden path climbed vines, destroyed palisades, and entered; it fell.
translations.idiomatic: Ting took a hidden path, climbed vines, destroyed palisades, and entered. The pass fell.

sentences.zh: 四月朔，師屯白石，應龍率諸苗決死戰。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fourth month the army encamped at Baishi; Yinglong led the various Miao in a fight to the death.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month the army encamped at Baishi. Yinglong led the various Miao tribes in a fight to the death.

sentences.zh: 綎親勒騎沖中堅，分兩翼夾擊，敗之。

translations.literal: Ting personally led cavalry charging the center, divided two wings to attack from both sides, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Ting personally led cavalry against the center, sent two wings to attack from both sides, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 追奔至養馬城，連破龍爪、海雲險囤，壓海龍囤，賊所倚天險，謂飛鳥騰猿不能逾者。
