translations.literal: Pursuing the rout to Yangmacheng, he took in succession the perilous stockades Longzhao and Haiyun and pressed on Hailong stockade, the bandits' reliance on heaven's peril, which they said neither flying birds nor leaping apes could cross.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing the rout to Yangmacheng, he took the perilous stockades Longzhao and Haiyun in succession and pressed on Hailong stockade, the rebels' stronghold on heaven's own cliff, which they said neither bird nor ape could cross.

sentences.zh: 時偏沅師已破青蛇囤，安疆臣亦奪落濛關，至大水田，焚桃溪莊。

translations.literal: At the time the Pianyuan army had already broken Qingshe stockade; An Jiangchen also seized Luomeng Pass, reached Dashuitian, and burned Taoxi manor.
translations.idiomatic: By then the Pianyuan column had broken Qingshe stockade. An Jiangchen had also seized Luomeng Pass, reached Dashuitian, and burned Taoxi manor.

sentences.zh: 賊見勢急，父子相抱哭，上囤死守，每路投降文緩師。

translations.literal: Seeing the situation urgent, the bandits father and son embraced and wept, went up the stockade to defend to the death, and on each route sent surrender documents to delay the army.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing the situation desperate, father and son embraced and wept, retreated to the stockade to defend to the death, and sent surrender documents along each route to delay the army.

sentences.zh: 總兵吳廣入崖門關，營水牛塘，與賊力戰三日，卻之。

translations.literal: Grand Commander Wu Guang entered Yamen Pass, encamped at Shuiniutang, fought the bandits fiercely for three days, and repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commander Wu Guang entered Yamen Pass, encamped at Shuiniutang, fought the rebels fiercely for three days, and repelled them.

sentences.zh: 賊詭令婦人於囤上拜表痛哭云：「田氏且降。

translations.literal: The bandits deceitfully had women on the stockade present a memorial and weep, saying: "The Tian clan is about to surrender."
translations.idiomatic: The rebels deceitfully had women on the stockade present a memorial and weep, saying: "The Tian clan is about to surrender."

sentences.zh: 」復訴為應龍仰藥死報廣，廣輕信按兵。

translations.literal: They again reported that Yinglong had died by taking poison; Guang lightly believed and held his troops.
translations.idiomatic: They again reported that Yinglong had died by poison. Guang believed it and held his troops.

sentences.zh: 已，覘賊詐，益厲兵攻，燒二關，奪賊樵汲路。

translations.literal: Thereafter, seeing through the bandits' deceit, he pressed the attack all the more, burned two passes, and seized the bandits' paths for firewood and water.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, seeing through the deception, he pressed the attack all the more, burned two passes, and cut off the rebels' paths for firewood and water.

sentences.zh: 八路師大集海龍囤，遂築長圍，更番叠攻。

translations.literal: The eight-route armies greatly assembled at Hailong stockade, then built a long encirclement and attacked in relays.
translations.idiomatic: The eight columns assembled at Hailong stockade, built a long encirclement, and attacked in relays.

sentences.zh: 賊知必死。

translations.literal: The bandits knew they must die.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels knew they were doomed.

sentences.zh: 會化龍聞父喪，詔以缞墨視師。

translations.literal: It happened that Hualong heard of his father's death; an edict ordered him to command the army in mourning garb without laying aside duties.
translations.idiomatic: Hualong then heard of his father's death. An edict ordered him to command the army in mourning garb without laying aside his duties.

sentences.zh: 化龍念賊前囤險不能越，令馬孔英率兵並力攻其後。

translations.literal: Hualong, considering the bandits' forward stockade perilous and impassable, ordered Ma Kongying to lead troops and attack their rear with combined force.
translations.idiomatic: Hualong, finding the rebels' forward stockade impassable, ordered Ma Kongying to lead troops and attack their rear with combined force.

sentences.zh: 天苦雨，將士馳泥淖中苦戰。

translations.literal: Heaven sent bitter rain; officers and soldiers charged through mud and mire in bitter fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell incessantly. Officers and soldiers fought bitterly through mud and mire.

sentences.zh: 六月四日，天忽霽，綎先士卒，克土城。

translations.literal: On the fourth day of the sixth month heaven suddenly cleared; Ting led from the front and took the earthen wall.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day of the sixth month the sky suddenly cleared. Ting led from the front and took the earthen wall.

sentences.zh: 應龍益迫，散金募死士拒戰，無應者。

translations.literal: Yinglong grew ever more pressed, scattered gold to recruit men willing to die resisting, and none answered.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong grew desperate, scattered gold to recruit men willing to die resisting, and none answered.

sentences.zh: 起，提刀巡壘，見四面火光燭天，大兵已登囤，破土城入。

translations.literal: He rose, took a knife and patrolled the ramparts, saw firelight on all four sides lighting heaven, the great army had already climbed the stockade, broken the earthen wall, and entered.
translations.idiomatic: He rose, took a knife, and patrolled the ramparts. Firelight blazed on all four sides. The main army had already climbed the stockade, broken the earthen wall, and entered.

sentences.zh: 應龍倉皇同愛妾二闔室縊，且自焚。

translations.literal: Yinglong in panic together with two favorite concubines hanged themselves in closed chambers and also set himself on fire.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong in panic hanged himself together with two favorite concubines and also set himself on fire.

sentences.zh: 吳廣獲其子朝棟，急覓應龍屍，出焰中。

translations.literal: Wu Guang captured his son Chaodong and urgently sought Yinglong's corpse, pulling it from the flames.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Guang captured his son Chaodong and urgently sought Yinglong's corpse, pulling it from the flames.

sentences.zh: 賊平。

translations.literal: The bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The rebellion was suppressed.

sentences.zh: 計出師至滅賊，百十有四日，八路共斬級二萬余，生獲朝棟等百余人。

translations.literal: Counting from the campaign's start to the bandits' destruction, one hundred fourteen days; the eight routes together cut more than twenty thousand heads and captured alive Chaodong and more than one hundred others.
translations.idiomatic: From the campaign's start to the rebels' destruction took one hundred fourteen days. The eight columns together cut more than twenty thousand heads and captured alive Chaodong and more than one hundred others.

sentences.zh: 化龍露布以聞，獻俘闕下，剉應龍屍，磔朝棟、兆龍等於市。

translations.literal: Hualong sent a victory bulletin to report upward, presented captives below the palace, minced Yinglong's corpse, and dismembered Chaodong, Zhaolong, and others in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Hualong sent a victory bulletin to the court, presented captives at the palace, minced Yinglong's corpse, and dismembered Chaodong, Zhaolong, and others in the market.

sentences.zh: 播州自唐入楊氏，傳二十九世，八百余年，至應龍而亡。

translations.literal: Bozhou from the Tang passed into the Yang clan, transmitted twenty-nine generations for more than eight hundred years, and perished with Yinglong.
translations.idiomatic: Bozhou had passed to the Yang clan in the Tang and endured twenty-nine generations for more than eight hundred years before perishing with Yinglong.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，播州余逆吳洪、盧文秀等叛，總兵李應祥等討平之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year the Bozhou remnant rebels Wu Hong, Lu Wenxiu, and others rebelled; Grand Commander Li Yingxiang and others suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year the Bozhou remnant rebels Wu Hong, Lu Wenxiu, and others rebelled. Grand Commander Li Yingxiang and others put down the disturbance.

sentences.zh: 分播地為二，屬蜀者曰遵義府，屬黔者為平越府。

translations.literal: Bozhou territory was divided in two: that belonging to Shu was called Zunyi Prefecture, that belonging to Qian was Pingyue Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Bozhou territory was divided in two. The portion belonging to Shu became Zunyi Prefecture; the portion belonging to Qian became Pingyue Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 永寧宣撫司

translations.literal: Yongning Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office
translations.idiomatic: The Yongning Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office

sentences.zh: 永寧，唐藺州地。

translations.literal: Yongning was Lin Prefecture territory in the Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Yongning was the territory of Lin Prefecture in the Tang.

sentences.zh: 宋為滬州江安、合江二縣境。

translations.literal: Under the Song it was the border of Jiang'an and Hejiang counties in Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song it lay within Jiang'an and Hejiang counties in Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 元置永寧路，領筠連州及騰川縣，後改為永寧宣撫司。

translations.literal: The Yuan established Yongning Circuit, overseeing Junlian Prefecture and Tengchuan County; later it was changed to the Yongning Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan established Yongning Circuit, overseeing Junlian Prefecture and Tengchuan County. Later it became the Yongning Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office.

sentences.zh: 洪武四年平蜀，永寧內附，置永寧衛。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Hongwu Shu was pacified; Yongning submitted internally and Yongning Guard was established.
translations.idiomatic: When Shu was pacified in the fourth year of Hongwu, Yongning submitted and Yongning Guard was established.

sentences.zh: 六年，筠連州滕大寨蠻編張等叛，詐稱雲南兵，據湖南長寧諸州縣，命成都衛指揮袁洪討之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the Junlian Prefecture Tengdazhai barbarian Bian Zhang and others rebelled, falsely claimed to be Yunnan troops, and occupied Changning and other prefectures and counties in Hunan; Chengdu Guard Commander Yuan Hong was ordered to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the Tengdazhai tribesman Bian Zhang of Junlian Prefecture rebelled, falsely claimed to be Yunnan troops, and occupied Changning and other counties in Hunan. Chengdu Guard Commander Yuan Hong was ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 洪引兵至敘州慶符縣，攻破清平關，擒偽千戶李文質等。

translations.literal: Hong led troops to Qingfu County in Xuzhou, broke Qingping Pass, and captured the false battalion commander Li Wenzhi and others.
translations.idiomatic: Hong led troops to Qingfu County in Xuzhou, broke Qingping Pass, and captured the false battalion commander Li Wenzhi and others.

sentences.zh: 編張遁走，復以兵犯江安諸縣。

translations.literal: Bian Zhang fled; he again led troops to raid Jiang'an and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: Bian Zhang fled, then again led troops to raid Jiang'an and other counties.

sentences.zh: 洪追及之，又敗其眾，焚其九寨，獲編張子偽鎮撫張壽。

translations.literal: Hong pursued and caught up, again defeated his force, burned his nine stockades, and captured Bian Zhang's son, the false Pacification Commissioner Zhang Shou.
translations.idiomatic: Hong pursued and caught up, defeated his force again, burned his nine stockades, and captured Bian Zhang's son, the false Pacification Commissioner Zhang Shou.

sentences.zh: 編張遁匿溪洞，余黨散入雲南。

translations.literal: Bian Zhang fled and hid in stream caves; the remaining followers scattered into Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Bian Zhang fled and hid in mountain caves. The remaining followers scattered into Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之，敕諭洪曰：「南蠻叛服不常，不足罪。

translations.literal: The Emperor heard and instructed Hong: "The southern barbarians rebel and submit irregularly; this is not enough to blame."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor heard and instructed Hong: "The southern tribes rebel and submit by turns. This is not enough to blame them for."

sentences.zh: 既獲其俘，宜編為軍。

translations.literal: Since you have captured prisoners, they should be enrolled as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Since you have captured prisoners, enroll them as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 且駐境上，必以兵震之，使詟天威，無遺後患。

translations.literal: Moreover remain on the border and must awe them with troops so they fear heaven's majesty and leave no later trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Remain on the border and awe them with troops so they fear heaven's majesty and leave no later trouble.

sentences.zh: 」未幾，張復聚眾據滕大寨，洪移兵討敗之。

translations.literal: Before long Zhang again gathered a crowd and held Tengdazhai; Hong shifted troops and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Zhang gathered followers again and held Tengdazhai. Hong shifted troops and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 追至小芒部，張遁去，遂取得花寨，擒阿普等。

translations.literal: Pursuing to Xiaomangbu, Zhang fled; he then took Huazhai and captured Apu and others.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing to Xiaomangbu, Zhang fled. Hong then took Huazhai and captured Apu and others.

sentences.zh: 自是，張不敢復出，其寨悉平。

translations.literal: From then on Zhang dared not emerge again and all his stockades were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Zhang dared not emerge again, and all his stockades were pacified.

sentences.zh: 遂降筠連州為縣，屬敘州，以九姓長官司隸永寧安撫司。

translations.literal: Junlian Prefecture was then reduced to a county subordinate to Xuzhou, and the Nine-Clan Native Official Office was placed under the Yongning Pacification Assistant Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Junlian Prefecture was then reduced to a county subordinate to Xuzhou, and the Nine-Clan Native Official Office was placed under the Yongning Pacification Assistant Commission.

sentences.zh: 七年升永寧等處軍民安撫司為宣撫使司，秩正三品。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Yongning and other places Military-Civilian Pacification Assistant Commission was promoted to Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office, rank 3a.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the Yongning Military-Civilian Pacification Assistant Commission was promoted to a Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office of rank 3a.

sentences.zh: 八年以祿照為宣撫使。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Lu Zhao was made Pacification Assistant Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Lu Zhao was appointed Pacification Assistant Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十七年，永寧宣撫使祿照貢馬，詔賜鈔幣冠服，定三年一貢如例。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Yongning Pacification Assistant Commissioner Lu Zhao presented horses as tribute; an edict granted paper money, silks, and official robes and fixed tribute once every three years as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Yongning Pacification Assistant Commissioner Lu Zhao presented horses as tribute. An edict granted paper money, silks, and official robes and fixed tribute once every three years as precedent.

sentences.zh: 十八年，祿照遣弟阿居來朝，言比年賦馬皆已輸，惟糧不能如數。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Lu Zhao sent his younger brother Aju to court, saying that in recent years allotted horses had all been delivered but grain could not meet the quota.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Lu Zhao sent his younger brother Aju to court, saying that allotted horses had all been delivered in recent years but grain could not meet the quota.

sentences.zh: 緣大軍南征，蠻民驚竄，耕種失時，加以兵後疾疫死亡者多，故輸納不及。

translations.literal: Because the great army campaigned south, the barbarian people fled in alarm, planting missed its season, and moreover after the war plague killed many, therefore delivery could not keep up.
translations.idiomatic: The great army had campaigned south, the tribes fled in alarm, planting missed its season, and after the war plague killed many. Delivery therefore fell short.

sentences.zh: 命蠲之。

translations.literal: An order remitted it.
translations.idiomatic: The court remitted the shortfall.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，永寧宣撫言，所轄地水道有一百九十灘，其江門大灘有八十二處，皆石塞其流。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the Yongning Pacification Assistant Commissioner said that waterways in his jurisdiction had one hundred ninety rapids, of which the Jiangmen great rapids numbered eighty-two places, all blocked by stone in their flow.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year the Yongning Pacification Assistant Commissioner reported that waterways in his jurisdiction had one hundred ninety rapids, including eighty-two at Jiangmen, all blocked by stone.

sentences.zh: 詔景川侯曹震往疏鑿之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Jingchuan Marquis Cao Zhen to go dredge and cut them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Jingchuan Marquis Cao Zhen to go dredge them.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，震至瀘州按視，有枝河通永寧，乃鑿石削崖，以通漕運。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Zhen reached Luzhou to inspect; there was a branch river connecting to Yongning; he then cut stone and trimmed cliffs to open grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Zhen reached Luzhou to inspect. Finding a branch river connecting to Yongning, he cut stone and trimmed cliffs to open grain transport.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，以祿照子阿聶襲職。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year Lu Zhao's son Anie inherited the office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year Lu Zhao's son Anie inherited the office.

sentences.zh: 先是，祿照坐事逮至京，得直，還卒於途。

translations.literal: Earlier Lu Zhao had been arrested for an offense and taken to the capital; he was cleared, but died on the return journey.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Lu Zhao had been arrested for an offense and taken to the capital. He was cleared but died on the return journey.

sentences.zh: 其子阿聶與弟智皆在太學，遂以庶母奢尾署司事。

translations.literal: His sons Anie and Zhi were both in the Imperial Academy; therefore his concubine Shewei was left to manage office affairs.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Anie and Zhi were both in the Imperial Academy. His concubine Shewei was left to manage office affairs.

sentences.zh: 至是，奢尾入朝，請以阿聶襲，從之。

translations.literal: At this time Shewei came to court and asked that Anie inherit; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Shewei then came to court and asked that Anie inherit. The court approved.

sentences.zh: 永樂四年，免永寧荒田租。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongle rent on Yongning wasteland was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yongle, rent on Yongning wasteland was remitted.

sentences.zh: 宣德八年，故宣撫阿聶妻奢蘇朝貢。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xuande the former Pacification Assistant Commissioner's wife She Su came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Xuande the former Pacification Assistant Commissioner's wife She Su came to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 九年，宣撫奢蘇奏：「生儒皆土僚，朝廷所授官言語不通，難以訓誨。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Pacification Assistant Commissioner She Su memorialized: "The native scholars are all local tribesmen; officials appointed by the court do not share their language and are hard to instruct."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Pacification Assistant Commissioner She Su memorialized: "The native scholars are all local tribesmen. Officials appointed by the court do not speak their language and cannot instruct them properly."

sentences.zh: 永寧監生李源資厚學通，乞如雲南鶴慶府例，授為儒學訓導。

translations.literal: Yongning student Li Yuan is richly endowed and broadly learned; I beg that following the precedent of Heqing Prefecture in Yunnan he be appointed instructor of the Confucian school.
translations.idiomatic: Yongning student Li Yuan is richly endowed and broadly learned. I beg that following the precedent of Heqing Prefecture in Yunnan he be appointed instructor of the Confucian school.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved her request.

sentences.zh: 景泰二年，減永寧宣撫司稅課局鈔，以苗賊竊發，客商路阻，從布政司請也。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingtai the paper-money tax of the Yongning Pacification Assistant Commission's tax bureau was reduced because Miao bandits stole out and merchants' routes were blocked, following the provincial administration commission's request.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingtai the paper-money tax of the Yongning Pacification Assistant Commission's tax bureau was reduced because Miao rebels had emerged and merchants' routes were blocked, at the provincial administration commission's request.

sentences.zh: 成化元年，山都掌大壩等寨蠻賊分劫江安等縣，兵部以聞。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chenghua the Shanduzhang Daba and other stockade barbarian bandits raided in divisions Jiang'an and other counties; the Ministry of War reported upward.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chenghua the Shanduzhang Daba and other stockade rebels raided Jiang'an and other counties in separate bands. The Ministry of War reported upward.

sentences.zh: 二年，國子學錄黃明善奏：「四川山都掌蠻屢歲出沒，殺掠良民。

translations.literal: In the second year Imperial Academy Recorder Huang Mingshan memorialized: "The Shanduzhang barbarians of Sichuan emerge and hide year after year, killing and plundering good people."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Imperial Academy Recorder Huang Mingshan memorialized: "The Shanduzhang tribes of Sichuan emerge year after year, killing and plundering the people."

sentences.zh: 景泰元年招之復叛，天順六年撫之又反。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingtai they were summoned and again rebelled; in the sixth year of Tianshun they were pacified and again revolted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jingtai they were summoned and rebelled again. In the sixth year of Tianshun they were pacified and revolted again.

sentences.zh: 近總兵李安令永寧宣撫奢貴赴大壩招撫，亦未效。

translations.literal: Recently Grand Commander Li An ordered Yongning Pacification Assistant Commissioner She Gui to go to Daba to summon and pacify them, but this also had no effect.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Grand Commander Li An ordered Yongning Pacification Assistant Commissioner She Gui to go to Daba to summon and pacify them, but this also failed.

sentences.zh: 恐開釁無已，宜及大兵之集，早為定計，毋釀邊患。

translations.literal: I fear trouble will open without end; it is fitting, while the great army is assembling, to settle plans early and not brew frontier calamity.
translations.idiomatic: I fear trouble will never end. While the main army is assembling, plans should be settled early so frontier calamity is not brewed.

sentences.zh: 」三年，明善復言：「宋時多剛縣蠻為寇，用白芀子兵破之。

translations.literal: In the third year Mingshan again said: "In Song times the Duogang County barbarians were bandits and were broken with baiqizi troops."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Mingshan again said: "In Song times the Duogang County tribes raided as bandits and were defeated with baiqizi militia."

sentences.zh: 白芀子者，即今之民壯；

translations.literal: Baiqizi are today's militia;
translations.idiomatic: Baiqizi are today's militia.

sentences.zh: 多剛縣者，即今之都掌多剛寨也。

translations.literal: Duogang County is today's Shanduzhang Duogang stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Duogang County is today's Shanduzhang Duogang stockade.

sentences.zh: 前代用鄉兵有明效，宜急募民壯，以助官軍。

translations.literal: Former ages used local troops with clear effect; militia should urgently be recruited to assist the regular army.
translations.idiomatic: Former ages used local troops with clear effect. Militia should urgently be recruited to assist the regular army.

sentences.zh: 都掌水稻十月熟，宜督兵先時取其田禾，則三月之內蠻必餒矣。

translations.literal: Shanduzhang rice ripens in the tenth month; troops should be urged beforehand to seize their field grain, and within three months the barbarians will surely starve.
translations.idiomatic: Shanduzhang rice ripens in the tenth month. Troops should be sent beforehand to seize their harvest, and within three months the tribes will starve.

sentences.zh: 軍宜分三路：南從金鵝池攻大壩，中從戎縣攻箐前，北從高縣攻都掌。

translations.literal: The army should divide into three routes: south from Jinechi to attack Daba, center from Rong County to attack Qingqian, north from Gao County to attack Shanduzhang.
translations.idiomatic: The army should divide into three routes: south from Jinechi to attack Daba, center from Rong County to attack Qingqian, north from Gao County to attack Shanduzhang.

sentences.zh: 小寨破，大寨自拔。

translations.literal: When small stockades are broken, large stockades will fall of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: When small stockades fall, large stockades will collapse of themselves.

sentences.zh: 又大壩南百余裏為芒部，西南二百里為烏蒙，令二府土官截其險要。

translations.literal: Moreover, more than a hundred li south of Daba is Mangbu, two hundred li southwest is Wumeng; the native officials of the two prefectures should be ordered to cut off their strategic points.
translations.idiomatic: More than a hundred li south of Daba lies Mangbu, and two hundred li southwest lies Wumeng. The native officials of those two prefectures should be ordered to cut off the strategic passes.

sentences.zh: 更用火器自下而上，順鳳延熱，寨必可攻。

translations.literal: Further use fire weapons from below upward, spread heat with the wind, and the stockades can surely be taken.
translations.idiomatic: Use fire weapons from below upward, spread the blaze with the wind, and the stockades can surely be taken.

sentences.zh: 且征調土兵，須處置得宜，招募民壯，須賞罰必信。

translations.literal: Moreover in mobilizing native troops disposition must be proper; in recruiting militia rewards and punishments must be sure.
translations.idiomatic: In mobilizing native troops, disposition must be proper. In recruiting militia, rewards and punishments must be sure.

sentences.zh: 」詔總兵官參用之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the grand commander to consult and use these plans.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the grand commander to consult and use these plans.

sentences.zh: 時總督尚書程信亦奏：「都掌地勢險要，必得土兵響道。

translations.literal: At the time Grand Coordinator Minister Cheng Xin also memorialized: "Shanduzhang terrain is strategically perilous; native troops who know the paths are essential."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Cheng Xin also memorialized: "Shanduzhang terrain is strategically perilous. Native troops who know the paths are essential."

sentences.zh: 請敕東川、芒部、烏蒙、烏撒諸府兵，並速調湖廣永順、保靖兵，以備征遣。

translations.literal: I beg that troops of the prefectures of Dongchuan, Mangbu, Wumeng, and Wusa be ordered, and Yongshun and Baojing troops of Huguang quickly mobilized, to prepare for campaign dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that troops from Dongchuan, Mangbu, Wumeng, and Wusa be ordered, and Yongshun and Baojing troops from Huguang quickly mobilized, for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 」又請南京戰馬一千應用。

translations.literal: He also asked for one thousand Nanjing war horses for use.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked for one thousand Nanjing war horses.

sentences.zh: 皆報可。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 四年，信奏：「永寧宣撫奢貴開通運道，擒獲賊首，宜降璽書獎賚。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Xin memorialized: "Yongning Pacification Assistant Commissioner She Gui opened transport routes and captured bandit chiefs; an imperial letter of reward should be sent."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Xin memorialized: "Yongning Pacification Assistant Commissioner She Gui opened transport routes and captured rebel chiefs. An imperial letter of reward should be sent."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十六年，白羅羅羿子與都掌大壩蠻相攻，禮部侍郎周洪謨言：「臣敘人也，知敘蠻情。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year the Bailuoluo Yizi and the Shanduzhang Daba barbarians attacked one another; Vice Minister of Rites Zhou Hongmo said: "Your servant is a man of Xu and knows Xu barbarian conditions."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year the Bailuoluo Yizi and the Shanduzhang Daba tribes attacked one another. Vice Minister of Rites Zhou Hongmo said: "Your servant is a native of Xu and knows the tribes of Xu."

sentences.zh: 戎、珙、筠、高諸縣，在前代皆土官，國朝始代以流，言語性情不相習，用激變。

translations.literal: The counties of Rong, Gong, Jun, and Gao in former ages were all native officials; our dynasty first replaced them with regular administration; language and temperament do not accord, which provokes change.
translations.idiomatic: The counties of Rong, Gong, Jun, and Gao were all ruled by native officials in former ages. Our dynasty replaced them with regular administrators. Language and temperament do not accord, which provokes rebellion.

sentences.zh: 洪、永、宣、正四朝，四命將徂征，隨服隨叛。

translations.literal: In the four reigns of Hongwu, Yongle, Xuande, and Zhengtong, four times generals were ordered to campaign; they submitted as they rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the reigns of Hongwu, Yongle, Xuande, and Zhengtong, generals were sent four times to campaign. The tribes submitted as quickly as they rebelled.

sentences.zh: 景泰初，益滋蔓，至今為梗。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jingtai trouble spread all the more; to the present it is an obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jingtai the trouble spread further and remains an obstruction to this day.

sentences.zh: 臣向嘗言仍立土官治之，為久遠計。

translations.literal: Your servant once said native officials should still be established to govern them as a long-term plan.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant once proposed restoring native officials to govern them as a long-term plan.

sentences.zh: 而都御史汪浩僥幸邊功，誣殺所保土官及寨主二百余人，諸蠻怨入骨髓，轉肆劫掠。

translations.literal: But Censor-in-Chief Wang Hao, eager for frontier merit, falsely killed more than two hundred native officials and stockade chiefs he had recommended; the various barbarians hated to the marrow and turned to plunder all the more.
translations.idiomatic: But Censor-in-Chief Wang Hao, eager for frontier merit, falsely killed more than two hundred native officials and stockade chiefs he had recommended. The tribes hated him to the marrow and turned to plunder all the more.

sentences.zh: 及尚書程信統大兵，僅能克之。

translations.literal: When Minister Cheng Xin commanded the great army, he could barely subdue them.
translations.idiomatic: When Minister Cheng Xin commanded the main army, he could barely subdue them.

sentences.zh: 臣以謂及今順蠻人之情，擇其眾所推服者，許為大寨主，俾世襲，庶可相安。

translations.literal: Your servant holds that now, following the barbarians' feelings, choosing one whom the masses revere and submit to, allowing him as great stockade chief with hereditary succession, might bring mutual peace.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant holds that now, following tribal sentiment, the court should choose one whom the people revere, appoint him great stockade chief with hereditary succession, and thereby restore peace.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「白羅羅者，相傳為廣西流蠻，有眾數千，無統屬。

translations.literal: He also said: "The Bailuoluo are traditionally said to be drifting barbarians from Guangxi, numbering several thousand with no overarching leadership."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "The Bailuoluo are said to be drifting tribes from Guangxi, numbering several thousand with no overarching leadership."

sentences.zh: 景泰中，糾戎、珙苗，攻破長寧九縣，今又侵擾都掌。

translations.literal: In Jingtai they joined Rong and Gong Miao, broke Changning's nine counties, and now again harass Shanduzhang.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai they joined the Miao of Rong and Gong, overran Changning's nine counties, and now harass Shanduzhang again.

sentences.zh: 其所居，崖險箐深，既難剪滅，亦宜立長官司治之。

translations.literal: Where they dwell, cliffs are perilous and ravines deep; they are hard to cut down and destroy, and a Native Official Office should also be established to govern them.
translations.idiomatic: Where they dwell the cliffs are perilous and ravines deep. They are hard to destroy, and a Native Official Office should be established to govern them.

sentences.zh: 地近芒部，宜即隸之。

translations.literal: The land is near Mangbu and should immediately be placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: The land lies near Mangbu and should be placed under its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 羿子者，永寧宣撫所轄。

translations.literal: The Yizi are under the Yongning Pacification Assistant Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Yizi fall under the Yongning Pacification Assistant Commission.

sentences.zh: 而永寧乃雲、貴要沖，南跨赤水、畢節六七百里，以一柔婦人制數萬強梁之眾，故每肆劫掠。

translations.literal: Yet Yongning is a strategic pass of Yunnan and Guizhou, spanning six or seven hundred li south across Chishui and Bijie; a single gentle woman controls tens of thousands of fierce people, and therefore they plunder at will.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Yongning is a strategic pass between Yunnan and Guizhou, spanning six or seven hundred li south across Chishui and Bijie. A single woman governs tens of thousands of fierce tribesmen, and they therefore plunder at will.

sentences.zh: 臣以為宣撫土僚，仍令宣撫奢貴治之。

translations.literal: Your servant holds that the Pacification Assistant Commissioner is a local tribesman and should still be ordered to govern them.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant holds that Pacification Assistant Commissioner She Gui, a local tribesman, should still govern them.

sentences.zh: 其南境寨蠻近赤水、畢節要路者，宜立二長官司，仍隸永寧宣撫。

translations.literal: For stockade barbarians on the southern border near the strategic routes of Chishui and Bijie, two Native Official Offices should be established, still subordinate to Yongning Pacification Assistant Commission.
translations.idiomatic: For tribal stockades on the southern border near the strategic routes of Chishui and Bijie, two Native Official Offices should be established, still subordinate to the Yongning Pacification Assistant Commission.

sentences.zh: 夫土官有職無俸，無損國儲，有益邊備。

translations.literal: Native officials have office without salary, do not harm state stores, and benefit frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: Native officials hold office without salary, do not drain state coffers, and benefit frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，永寧宣撫司女土官奢祿獻大木，給誥如例。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year the female native official She Lu of the Yongning Pacification Assistant Commission presented great timbers and was granted patent of appointment as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year the female native official She Lu of the Yongning Pacification Assistant Commission presented great timbers and was granted a patent of appointment as precedent.

sentences.zh: 萬歷元年，四川巡撫曾省吾奏：「都蠻叛逆，發兵征討，土官奢效忠首在調，但與貴州土官安國亨有仇。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wanli Sichuan Grand Coordinator Zeng Shengwu memorialized: "The Du barbarians have rebelled and troops are sent to campaign; native official She Xiaozhong is foremost in mobilization, but he has enmity with Guizhou native official An Guoheng."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wanli, Sichuan Grand Coordinator Zeng Shengwu memorialized: "The Du tribes have rebelled and troops have been sent against them. Native official She Xiaozhong is foremost in mobilization, but he is at feud with Guizhou native official An Guoheng."

sentences.zh: 請並令總兵官劉顯節制，使不得藉口復仇，妄有騷動。

translations.literal: I beg that Grand Commander Liu Xian also be ordered to control them so they cannot use revenge as a pretext for reckless disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that Grand Commander Liu Xian also be ordered to restrain them so they cannot use revenge as a pretext for reckless disturbance.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 初，烏撒與永寧、烏蒙、水西、沾益諸土官境相連，復以世戚親厚。

translations.literal: Earlier Wusa bordered the native domains of Yongning, Wumeng, Shuixi, and Zhanyi, and moreover they were kin by generations of marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Wusa bordered the native domains of Yongning, Wumeng, Shuixi, and Zhanyi, and they were bound by generations of marriage alliances.

sentences.zh: 既而安國亨殺安信，信兄智結永寧宣撫奢效忠報仇，彼此相攻。

translations.literal: Thereafter An Guoheng killed An Xin; Xin's elder brother Zhi joined Yongning Pacification Assistant Commissioner She Xiaozhong to avenge him, and they attacked one another.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter An Guoheng killed An Xin. Xin's elder brother Zhi joined Yongning Pacification Assistant Commissioner She Xiaozhong to avenge him, and they attacked one another.

sentences.zh: 而安國亨部下吏目與智有親，恐為國亨所殺，因投安路墨。

translations.literal: But An Guoheng's clerk was kin to Zhi and feared being killed by Guoheng; he therefore fled to An Lumi.
translations.idiomatic: An Guoheng's clerk was kin to Zhi and feared being killed by Guoheng. He therefore fled to An Lumi.

sentences.zh: 墨詐稱為土知府安承祖，赴京代奏。

translations.literal: Lumi falsely claimed to be native prefect An Chengzu and went to the capital to memorialize on his behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Lumi falsely claimed to be native prefect An Chengzu and went to the capital to memorialize on his behalf.

sentences.zh: 已而國亨亦令其子安民陳訴，與奢效忠俱奉命聽勘於川貴巡撫。

translations.literal: Thereafter Guoheng also had his son Anmin present a petition; both he and She Xiaozhong were ordered to submit to investigation by the Sichuan and Guizhou grand coordinators.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Guoheng also had his son Anmin present a petition. Both he and She Xiaozhong were ordered to submit to investigation by the Sichuan and Guizhou grand coordinators.

sentences.zh: 議照蠻俗罰牛贖罪，報可。

translations.literal: It was deliberated that according to barbarian custom they should pay an ox as ransom for guilt; the reply approved.
translations.idiomatic: It was decided that according to tribal custom they should pay an ox as ransom. The court approved.

sentences.zh: 效忠死，妻世統無子，妾世續有幼子崇周。

translations.literal: Xiaozhong died; his wife Shitong had no son; his concubine Shixu had the young son Chongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozhong died. His wife Shitong had no son. His concubine Shixu had the young son Chongzhou.

sentences.zh: 世統以嫡欲奪印，相仇殺。

translations.literal: Shitong as principal wife wished to seize the seal; they killed one another in enmity.
translations.idiomatic: Shitong as principal wife wished to seize the seal, and they killed one another in the feud.

sentences.zh: 方奏報間，總兵郭成、參將馬呈文利其所有，遽發兵千余，深入落紅。

translations.literal: While memorials were being reported, Grand Commander Guo Cheng and Vice Commander Ma Chengwen, coveting their possessions, suddenly sent more than a thousand troops deep into Luohong.
translations.idiomatic: While memorials were being reported, Grand Commander Guo Cheng and Vice Commander Ma Chengwen, coveting their possessions, suddenly sent more than a thousand troops deep into Luohong.

sentences.zh: 奢氏九世所積，搜掠一空。

translations.literal: What the She clan had accumulated over nine generations was searched and plundered clean.
translations.idiomatic: What the She clan had accumulated over nine generations was searched and plundered clean.

sentences.zh: 世續亦發兵尾其後。

translations.literal: Shixu also sent troops to follow in their rear.
translations.idiomatic: Shixu also sent troops to follow in their rear.

sentences.zh: 效忠弟沙卜出拒戰，且邀水西兵報仇。

translations.literal: Xiaozhong's younger brother Shabuchu came out to resist and also invited Shuixi troops to avenge.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozhong's younger brother Shabuchu came out to resist and invited Shuixi troops to join the fight.

sentences.zh: 成兵敗績，乃檄取沙卜於世統，統不應，復殺把總三人，聚苗兵萬余，欲攻永寧泄怨。

translations.literal: Cheng's army was defeated; he then dispatched orders to take Shabuchu from Shitong; Tong did not respond, again killed three platoon commanders, gathered more than ten thousand Miao troops, and wished to attack Yongning to vent grievance.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng's army was defeated. He then ordered Shitong to surrender Shabuchu. She refused, killed three platoon commanders, gathered more than ten thousand Miao troops, and prepared to attack Yongning to vent her grievance.

sentences.zh: 巡按劾成等邀利起釁，宜逮；

translations.literal: The investigating censor impeached Cheng and others for provoking trouble to seek profit and held they should be arrested;
translations.idiomatic: The investigating censor impeached Cheng and others for provoking trouble to seek profit and held they should be arrested.

sentences.zh: 而議予二土婦冠帶，仍分地各管所屬，其宣撫司印俟奢崇周成立，赴襲理事。

translations.literal: yet it was proposed to grant the two native women robes and belt, still divide land for each to govern her following, and the Pacification Assistant Commission seal should await She Chongzhou's coming of age to inherit and manage affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yet it was proposed to grant the two native women robes and belt, divide land for each to govern her following, and withhold the Pacification Assistant Commission seal until She Chongzhou came of age to inherit and manage affairs.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: The reply approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十四年，奢崇周代職，未幾死。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year She Chongzhou succeeded to office and soon died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year She Chongzhou succeeded to office and soon died.

sentences.zh: 奢崇明者，效忠親弟盡忠子也。

translations.literal: She Chongming was the son of Xiaozhong's younger brother Jinzhong.
translations.idiomatic: She Chongming was the son of Xiaozhong's younger brother Jinzhong.

sentences.zh: 幼孤，依世統撫養一十三年。

translations.literal: Orphaned young, he was raised by Shitong for thirteen years.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned young, he was raised by Shitong for thirteen years.

sentences.zh: 至是，送之永寧，世續遺之氈馬，許出印給之。

translations.literal: At this time he was sent to Yongning; Shixu gave him felt and horses and promised to release the seal to him.
translations.idiomatic: He was then sent to Yongning. Shixu gave him felt and horses and promised to release the seal to him.

sentences.zh: 事已定，而諸奸閻宗傳等自以昔從世續逐世統，殺沙卜，懼崇明立，必復前恨，遂附水西，立阿利以自固。

translations.literal: The matter was settled, but the villains Yan Zongchuan and others, knowing they had once followed Shixu to drive out Shitong and kill Shabuchu, feared that if Chongming were established they would surely revisit old hatred; they therefore attached themselves to Shuixi and set up Ali to secure themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The matter seemed settled, but the villains Yan Zongchuan and others, knowing they had once helped Shixu drive out Shitong and kill Shabuchu, feared Chongming would revisit old scores. They attached themselves to Shuixi and set up Ali to secure themselves.

sentences.zh: 安疆臣陰陽其間，蠻兵四出，焚劫屯堡，官兵不能禁。

translations.literal: An Jiangchen played both sides; barbarian troops went out on all sides, burned and plundered colonies and forts, and regular troops could not restrain them.
translations.idiomatic: An Jiangchen played both sides. Tribal troops raided on all sides, burning colonies and forts, and regular troops could not restrain them.

sentences.zh: 總督以聞，朝議命奢崇明暫管宣撫事，冀崇明蠲夙恨，以收人心。

translations.literal: The grand coordinator reported upward; court deliberation ordered She Chongming temporarily to manage Pacification Assistant affairs, hoping Chongming would put aside old hatred to win people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: The grand coordinator reported upward. The court ordered She Chongming temporarily to manage Pacification Assistant affairs, hoping he would put aside old hatred and win people's hearts.

sentences.zh: 而閻宗傳等攻掠永寧、普市、麾尼如故。

translations.literal: But Yan Zongchuan and others attacked and plundered Yongning, Pushi, and Huini as before.
translations.idiomatic: But Yan Zongchuan and others attacked and plundered Yongning, Pushi, and Huini as before.

sentences.zh: 崇明承襲幾一載，世續印竟不與，且以印私安疆臣妻弟阿利。

translations.literal: Chongming had inherited for nearly a year, yet Shixu still would not give the seal, and moreover privately gave the seal to An Jiangchen's wife's younger brother Ali.
translations.idiomatic: Chongming had inherited for nearly a year, yet Shixu still withheld the seal and privately gave it to An Jiangchen's brother-in-law Ali.

sentences.zh: 巡撫遣都司張神武執世續索印，世續言印在鎮雄隴澄處。

translations.literal: The grand coordinator sent Regional Commander Zhang Shenwu to seize Shixu and demand the seal; Shixu said the seal was with Long Cheng of Zhenxiong.
translations.idiomatic: The grand coordinator sent Regional Commander Zhang Shenwu to seize Shixu and demand the seal. Shixu said the seal was with Long Cheng of Zhenxiong.

sentences.zh: 隴澄者，水西安堯臣也。

translations.literal: Long Cheng was An Yaochan of Shuixi.
translations.idiomatic: Long Cheng was An Yaochan of Shuixi.

sentences.zh: 隴氏垂絕，堯臣入贅，遂冒隴姓，稱隴澄。

translations.literal: The Long clan was near extinction; Yaochan entered as son-in-law, then usurped the Long surname and called himself Long Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: The Long clan was near extinction. Yaochan married into the family, usurped the Long surname, and called himself Long Cheng.

sentences.zh: 敘平播州、敘州功，澄與焉，中朝不知其為堯臣也。

translations.literal: In reporting merit for pacifying Bozhou and Xuzhou, Cheng was included, and the central court did not know he was Yaochan.
translations.idiomatic: In reporting merit for pacifying Bozhou and Xuzhou, Cheng was included, and the central court did not know he was Yaochan.

sentences.zh: 堯臣外怙播功，內仗水西，有據鎮雄制永寧心。

translations.literal: Yaochan outwardly relied on Bozhou merit, inwardly depended on Shuixi, and had a mind to hold Zhenxiong and control Yongning.
translations.idiomatic: Yaochan outwardly relied on Bozhou merit, inwardly depended on Shuixi, and aimed to hold Zhenxiong and control Yongning.

sentences.zh: 蜀撫按以堯臣非隴氏種，無授鎮雄意。

translations.literal: Shu grand coordinators and censors held that Yaochan was not of Long clan seed and had no intention to grant Zhenxiong.
translations.idiomatic: Shu grand coordinators and censors held that Yaochan was not of Long clan blood and had no intention of granting him Zhenxiong.

sentences.zh: 堯臣以是懷兩端，陰助世續。

translations.literal: Yaochan therefore harbored two minds and secretly aided Shixu.
translations.idiomatic: Yaochan therefore played both sides and secretly aided Shixu.

sentences.zh: 意世續得授阿利，則己據鎮雄益堅。

translations.literal: He intended that if Shixu could invest Ali, then his hold on Zhenxiong would be all the firmer.
translations.idiomatic: He intended that if Shixu could invest Ali, his hold on Zhenxiong would be all the firmer.

sentences.zh: 又朝廷厭兵，宗傳、阿利等方驛騷，己可臥取隴氏也。

translations.literal: Moreover the court was weary of war; Zongchuan, Ali, and others were just making relay-post trouble, and he could take the Long clan while lying down.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the court was weary of war. Zongchuan, Ali, and others were stirring trouble along the relay routes, and he could seize the Long domain without effort.

sentences.zh: 而閻宗傳等每焚掠，必稱鎮雄兵，以怖諸部。

translations.literal: Whenever Zongchuan and others burned and plundered, they always claimed to be Zhenxiong troops to terrify the various domains.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Zongchuan and others burned and plundered, they claimed to be Zhenxiong troops to terrify the various domains.

sentences.zh: 川南道梅國樓所俘蠻醜者言，鎮雄遣將魯大功督兵五營屯大壩，水西兵已渡馬鈴堡，約攻永寧，普市遂潰，宗傳等以空城棄去。

translations.literal: A captured barbarian chieftain of Meiguolou on the Southern Sichuan Circuit said Zhenxiong had sent the general Lu Dagong supervising five battalions encamped at Daba, Shuixi troops had already crossed Maling Fort, agreed to attack Yongning, Pushi then collapsed, and Zongchuan and others abandoned the empty city.
translations.idiomatic: A captured tribal chieftain told Meiguolou of the Southern Sichuan Circuit that Zhenxiong had sent General Lu Dagong with five battalions to camp at Daba, that Shuixi troops had crossed Maling Fort and agreed to attack Yongning, that Pushi then collapsed, and that Zongchuan and others abandoned the empty city.

sentences.zh: 奢崇明又言，堯臣所遣目把彭月政、魯仲賢六大營助逆不退，聲言將抵敘南，攻永寧、滬州。

translations.literal: She Chongming also said that the headmen Peng Yuezheng and Lu Zhongxian whom Yaochan had sent with six great camps aided the rebels and would not withdraw, proclaiming they would reach southern Xu and attack Yongning and Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: She Chongming also reported that headmen Peng Yuezheng and Lu Zhongxian, whom Yaochan had sent with six camps, aided the rebels and would not withdraw, proclaiming they would reach southern Xu and attack Yongning and Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 於是總兵侯國弼等，皆歸惡於堯臣。

translations.literal: Thereupon Grand Commanders Hou Guobi and others all attributed the evil to Yaochan.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commanders Hou Guobi and others then attributed the evil to Yaochan.

sentences.zh: 都司張神武等所俘喚者、朗者，皆鎮雄土目，堯臣亦不能解。

translations.literal: The captives Huan and Lang taken by Regional Commander Zhang Shenwu and others were all Zhenxiong native headmen; Yaochan likewise could not explain it away.
translations.idiomatic: The captives Huan and Lang taken by Regional Commander Zhang Shenwu and others were all Zhenxiong native headmen. Yaochan could not explain it away.

sentences.zh: 黔中撫按以西南多事，兵食俱詘，無意取鎮雄。

translations.literal: Qianzhong grand coordinators and censors, because the southwest had many troubles and troops and grain were both exhausted, had no mind to take Zhenxiong.
translations.idiomatic: Qianzhong grand coordinators and censors, because the southwest had many troubles and troops and grain were exhausted, had no mind to take Zhenxiong.

sentences.zh: 堯臣因以普市、摩尼諸焚掠，皆歸之蜀將。

translations.literal: Yaochan therefore attributed the burnings and plunderings of Pushi, Moni, and others to Shu generals.
translations.idiomatic: Yaochan therefore attributed the burnings and plunderings of Pushi, Moni, and others to Shu generals.

sentences.zh: 議者遂以貪功起釁，為蜀將罪。

translations.literal: Deliberators then took greed for merit and provoking trouble as the Shu generals' crime.
translations.idiomatic: Deliberators then blamed the Shu generals for provoking trouble out of greed for merit.

sentences.zh: 四川巡撫喬璧星言：「堯臣狡謀，欲篡鎮雄，垂涎蘭地有年矣。

translations.literal: Sichuan Grand Coordinator Qiao Bixing said: "Yaochan's crafty plot wishes to usurp Zhenxiong; he has coveted Lan territory for years."
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Grand Coordinator Qiao Bixing said: "Yaochan plots craftily to usurp Zhenxiong and has coveted Lan territory for years."

sentences.zh: 宗傳之背逆恃鎮雄，猶鎮雄之恃水西也。

translations.literal: Zongchuan's rebellion relies on Zhenxiong, just as Zhenxiong relies on Shuixi.
translations.idiomatic: Zongchuan's rebellion relies on Zhenxiong, just as Zhenxiong relies on Shuixi.

sentences.zh: 水西疆臣不助兵，臣已得其狀，宜乘逆孽未成，令貴州撫按調兵與臣會剿。

translations.literal: Shuixi frontier minister will not aid troops; your servant has already obtained proof; it is fitting, while the rebel brood is not yet formed, to order Guizhou grand coordinators to mobilize troops and join your servant in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: The Shuixi frontier minister will not aid troops, and your servant has proof. While the rebels are not yet fully formed, Guizhou should mobilize troops to join your servant in suppression.

sentences.zh: 倘堯臣稔惡如故，臣即移師擊之，毋使弗摧之虺復為蛇，弗窒之罅復為河也。

translations.literal: If Yaochan accumulates evil as before, your servant will then shift troops to strike him, lest an uncrushed young snake become a serpent again, lest an unstopped crack become a river.
translations.idiomatic: If Yaochan persists in evil, your servant will shift troops to strike him, lest an uncrushed young snake grow into a serpent and an unstopped crack become a river.

sentences.zh: 」疏上，廷議無敢決用師者。

translations.literal: When the memorial went up, court deliberation had none who dared decide to use troops.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial went up, no one at court dared decide to use troops.

sentences.zh: 久之，阿利死，印亦出，蜀中欲逐堯臣之論，卒不可解。

translations.literal: After long time Ali died and the seal also emerged; the Shu talk of expelling Yaochan ultimately could not be resolved.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time Ali died and the seal emerged, but the Shu proposal to expel Yaochan ultimately could not be resolved.

sentences.zh: 時播州清疆之議方沸騰，黔、蜀各紛紛。

translations.literal: At the time deliberation on clearing Bozhou borders was boiling; Qian and Shu each disputed.
translations.idiomatic: At the time deliberation on clearing Bozhou borders was boiling, and Qian and Shu disputed fiercely.

sentences.zh: 至是，永寧議兵又如聚訟矣。

translations.literal: By then Yongning military deliberation was again like a crowd at lawsuit.
translations.idiomatic: By then deliberation over Yongning military affairs was again like a crowd at lawsuit.

sentences.zh: 時朝廷已一意休兵。

translations.literal: At the time the court had already set its mind solely on resting troops.
translations.idiomatic: The court had already set its mind solely on resting troops.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，命釋奢世續，赦閻宗傳等罪，訪求隴氏子孫為鎮雄後。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year an order released She Shixu, pardoned the crimes of Yan Zongchuan and others, and sought descendants of the Long clan as heirs of Zhenxiong.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year the court released She Shixu, pardoned Yan Zongchuan and others, and sought descendants of the Long clan as heirs of Zhenxiong.

sentences.zh: 並令安疆臣約束堯臣歸本土司，聽遙授職銜，不許冒襲隴職。

translations.literal: An Jiangchen was also ordered to restrain Yaochan to return to his native commission, allowed to receive rank in absentia, and not permitted falsely to inherit Long office.
translations.idiomatic: An Jiangchen was also ordered to restrain Yaochan and return him to his native commission, allowed to receive rank in absentia, and forbidden falsely to inherit Long office.

sentences.zh: 於是宗傳降，堯臣請避去，黔督遂請撤師。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zongchuan submitted; Yaochan asked to withdraw; the Qian grand coordinator then asked to withdraw troops.
translations.idiomatic: Zongchuan then submitted. Yaochan asked to withdraw, and the Qian grand coordinator asked to withdraw troops.

sentences.zh: 舊制，永寧衛隸黔，土司隸蜀。

translations.literal: By old regulation Yongning Guard was subordinate to Qian and native chieftains to Shu.
translations.idiomatic: By old regulation Yongning Guard was subordinate to Qian and native chieftains to Shu.

sentences.zh: 自水、蘭交攻，軍民激變，奢崇明雖立，而行勘未報。

translations.literal: Since Shuixi and Lan fought each other, soldiers and civilians were provoked to mutiny; though She Chongming was established, the traveling investigation had not been reported.
translations.idiomatic: Since Shuixi and Lan fought each other, soldiers and civilians were provoked to mutiny. Though She Chongming was established, the investigation had not been concluded.

sentences.zh: 摩尼、普市千戶張大策等復請將永寧宣撫改土為流。

translations.literal: The Moni and Pushi battalion commanders Zhang Dace and others again asked to change Yongning Pacification Assistant Commission from native to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: The Moni and Pushi battalion commanders Zhang Dace and others again asked to convert the Yongning Pacification Assistant Commission from native to regular administration.

sentences.zh: 兵部言，無故改流，置崇明何地，命速完前勘諸案。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said that to change to regular administration without cause left Chongming nowhere; it ordered the former investigation cases quickly completed.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War said that converting to regular administration without cause left Chongming nowhere and ordered the former investigation cases completed quickly.

sentences.zh: 於是蜀撫擬張大策以失守城池罪，應斬，黔撫擬張神武以擅兵劫掠，罪亦應斬。

translations.literal: Thereupon Shu grand coordinator proposed Zhang Dace for the crime of losing the city and garrison, deserving execution; Qian grand coordinator proposed Zhang Shenwu for mobilizing troops to plunder, the crime also deserving execution.
translations.idiomatic: The Shu grand coordinator proposed Zhang Dace for losing the city, deserving execution. The Qian grand coordinator proposed Zhang Shenwu for mobilizing troops to plunder, also deserving execution.

sentences.zh: 策斬策，黔人，武，蜀人也。

translations.literal: Ce was executed; Ce was a man of Qian; Wu was a man of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Dace was executed. Dace was a man of Qian; Shenwu was a man of Shu.

sentences.zh: 由是兩情皆不平，諸臣自相構訟，復紛結不解。

translations.literal: From this both sides were discontent; the various officials sued one another and again tangled without resolution.
translations.idiomatic: Both sides were discontent. Officials sued one another, and the tangle remained unresolved.

sentences.zh: 會奢崇明子寅與水西已故土官妻奢社輝爭地，安兵馬十倍奢，而奢之兵精，兩相持。

translations.literal: It happened that She Chongming's son Yin and the wife of the deceased Shuixi native official, She Shehui, disputed land; An's horses and troops were tenfold She's, yet She's troops were elite, and the two sides faced off.
translations.idiomatic: She Chongming's son Yin and the wife of the deceased Shuixi native official, She Shehui, disputed land. An's forces outnumbered She's tenfold, yet She's troops were elite, and the two sides faced off.

sentences.zh: 蜀、黔撫按不能制，以狀聞。

translations.literal: Shu and Qian grand coordinators and censors could not control it and reported the situation upward.
translations.idiomatic: Shu and Qian grand coordinators and censors could not control it and reported upward.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，黔撫張鶴鳴以赤水衛白撒所屯地為永寧占據，宜清還，皆待勘未決。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year Qian Grand Coordinator Zhang Heming held that colony land of Baisha Station in Chishui Guard was occupied by Yongning and should be cleared and returned; all awaited investigation undecided.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year Qian Grand Coordinator Zhang Heming held that colony land of Baisha Station in Chishui Guard was occupied by Yongning and should be returned. All awaited investigation.

sentences.zh: 天啟元年，崇明請調馬步兵二萬援遼，從之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianqi Chongming asked to mobilize twenty thousand horse and foot to aid Liaodong; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianqi, Chongming asked to mobilize twenty thousand horse and foot to aid Liaodong. The court approved.

sentences.zh: 崇明與子寅久蓄異志，借調兵援遼，遣其婿樊龍、部黨張彤等，領兵至重慶，久駐不發。

translations.literal: Chongming and his son Yin had long harbored rebellious intent; borrowing mobilization to aid Liaodong, he sent his son-in-law Fan Long, follower Zhang Tong, and others leading troops to Chongqing, where they long encamped without setting out.
translations.idiomatic: Chongming and his son Yin had long harbored rebellious intent. Borrowing the mobilization to aid Liaodong, he sent his son-in-law Fan Long, follower Zhang Tong, and others with troops to Chongqing, where they encamped for a long time without setting out.

sentences.zh: 巡撫徐可求移鎮重慶，趣永寧兵。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Xu Keqiu moved his headquarters to Chongqing and urged Yongning troops forward.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Xu Keqiu moved his headquarters to Chongqing and urged the Yongning troops forward.

sentences.zh: 樊龍等以增行糧為名乘機反，殺巡撫、道、府、總兵等官二十余員，遂據重慶。

translations.literal: Fan Long and others, under the name of increasing march grain, seized the moment to rebel, killed more than twenty officials including the grand coordinator, circuit intendant, prefect, and grand commander, and then held Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Long and others, under the pretext of increasing march grain, seized the moment to rebel, killed more than twenty officials including the grand coordinator, circuit intendant, prefect, and grand commander, and seized Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 分兵攻合江、納溪，破滬州，陷遵義，興文知縣張振德死之。

translations.literal: They divided troops to attack Hejiang and Naxi, broke Luzhou, took Zunyi; Xingwen Magistrate Zhang Zhende died.
translations.idiomatic: They divided troops to attack Hejiang and Naxi, overran Luzhou, took Zunyi, and Xingwen Magistrate Zhang Zhende died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 興文，故九絲蠻地也。

translations.literal: Xingwen was formerly Jiusi barbarian land.
translations.idiomatic: Xingwen was formerly the land of the Jiusi tribes.

sentences.zh: 進圍成都，偽號大梁，布政使朱燮元、周著，按察使林宰分門固守。

translations.literal: Advancing to besiege Chengdu, they falsely styled themselves Great Liang; Administrative Commissioners Zhu Xieyuan and Zhou Zhuo and Surveillance Commissioner Lin Zai each guarded a gate.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to besiege Chengdu, they styled themselves Great Liang. Administrative Commissioners Zhu Xieyuan and Zhou Zhuo and Surveillance Commissioner Lin Zai each guarded a gate.

sentences.zh: 石砫土司女官秦良玉遣弟民屏、侄翼明等，發兵四千，倍道兼行，潛渡重慶，營南坪關。

translations.literal: Shizhu native chieftain the female official Qin Liangyu sent her younger brother Minping, nephew Yiming, and others, mobilized four thousand troops, marched by double stages, secretly crossed Chongqing, and encamped at Nanping Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhu native chieftain Qin Liangyu sent her younger brother Minping, nephew Yiming, and others with four thousand troops. They marched by forced stages, secretly crossed Chongqing, and encamped at Nanping Pass.

sentences.zh: 良玉自統精兵六千，沿江上趨成都。

translations.literal: Liangyu herself commanded six thousand elite troops and hurried upriver toward Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: Liangyu herself commanded six thousand elite troops and hurried upriver toward Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 諸援兵亦漸集。

translations.literal: Various relief troops also gradually assembled.
translations.idiomatic: Relief troops also gradually assembled.

sentences.zh: 時寅攻城急，陰納劉勛等為內應，事覺伏誅。

translations.literal: At the time Yin pressed the siege urgently and secretly enlisted Liu Xun and others as inside responders; the matter was discovered and they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Yin pressed the siege urgently and secretly enlisted Liu Xun and others as inside collaborators. The plot was discovered and they were executed.

sentences.zh: 復造雲梯及旱船，晝夜薄城，城中亦以炮石擊毀之。

translations.literal: They again built cloud ladders and land boats and day and night pressed the walls; within the city cannon stones also struck and destroyed them.
translations.idiomatic: They built cloud ladders and land boats and pressed the walls day and night. The defenders struck and destroyed them with cannon stones.

sentences.zh: 相持百日，會賊將羅乾象遣人輸款，願殺賊自效。

translations.literal: They faced off for a hundred days; then the rebel general Luo Qianxiang sent someone to offer submission, willing to kill bandits to prove merit.
translations.idiomatic: They faced off for a hundred days. Then rebel general Luo Qianxiang offered submission, willing to kill rebels to prove his loyalty.

sentences.zh: 是夜，乾象縱火焚營，賊兵亂，崇明父子倉皇奔，錢帛谷米委棄山積，窮民賴以得活。

translations.literal: That night Qianxiang set fire and burned the camp; rebel troops fell into chaos; Chongming father and son fled in panic; money, silks, and grain were abandoned in mountain piles, and the poor relied on them to live.
translations.idiomatic: That night Qianxiang set fire to the camp. Rebel troops fell into chaos. Chongming and his son fled in panic, abandoning money, silks, and grain in mountain piles from which the poor were saved.

sentences.zh: 乾象因率其黨胡汝高等來降。

translations.literal: Qianxiang thereupon led his followers Hu Rugao and others to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Qianxiang then led his followers Hu Rugao and others to submit.

sentences.zh: 時燮元已授巡撫，率川卒追崇明，江安、新都、遵義諸郡邑皆復。

translations.literal: At the time Xieyuan had already been appointed grand coordinator; he led Sichuan troops to pursue Chongming; Jiang'an, Xindu, Zunyi, and other prefectures and counties were all recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Xieyuan had already been appointed grand coordinator. He led Sichuan troops to pursue Chongming, and Jiang'an, Xindu, Zunyi, and other prefectures and counties were recovered.

sentences.zh: 時二年三月也。

translations.literal: This was in the third month of the second year.
translations.idiomatic: This was in the third month of the second year.

sentences.zh: 樊龍收余眾數萬，據重慶險塞。

translations.literal: Fan Long gathered the remaining force of tens of thousands and held Chongqing's perilous passes.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Long gathered tens of thousands of survivors and held Chongqing's perilous passes.

sentences.zh: 燮元督良玉等奪二郎關，總兵杜文煥破佛圖關，諸將迫重慶而軍。

translations.literal: Xieyuan supervised Liangyu and others in seizing Erlang Pass; Grand Commander Du Wenhuan broke Fotu Pass; the generals pressed toward Chongqing with their armies.
translations.idiomatic: Xieyuan supervised Liangyu and others in seizing Erlang Pass. Grand Commander Du Wenhuan broke Fotu Pass. The generals pressed toward Chongqing with their armies.

sentences.zh: 奢寅遣賊黨周鼎等分道來救，鼎敗走，為合江民所縛。

translations.literal: She Yin sent rebel followers Zhou Ding and others by separate routes to rescue; Ding was defeated and fled, and was bound by Hejiang commoners.
translations.idiomatic: She Yin sent rebel followers Zhou Ding and others by separate routes to rescue Chongqing. Ding was defeated and bound by Hejiang commoners.

sentences.zh: 官軍與平茶、酉陽、石砫三土司合圍重慶，城中乏食。

translations.literal: Government troops joined the three native domains of Pingcha, Youyang, and Shizhu in besieging Chongqing; food in the city was exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops joined the three native domains of Pingcha, Youyang, and Shizhu in besieging Chongqing, where food ran short.

sentences.zh: 燮元遂以計擒樊龍，殺之，張彤亦為亂兵所殺，生擒龍子友邦及其黨張國用、石永高等三十余人，遂復重慶。

translations.literal: Xieyuan then by stratagem captured Fan Long and killed him; Zhang Tong was also killed by mutinous troops; Long's son Youbang and his followers Zhang Guoyong, Shi Yonggao, and more than thirty others were captured alive; Chongqing was then recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Xieyuan then captured Fan Long by stratagem and killed him. Zhang Tong was killed by mutinous troops. Long's son Youbang and followers Zhang Guoyong, Shi Yonggao, and more than thirty others were captured alive. Chongqing was recovered.

sentences.zh: 時安邦彥反於貴州，崇明遙倚為聲援。

translations.literal: At the time An Bangyan rebelled in Guizhou; Chongming remotely relied on him as vocal support.
translations.idiomatic: An Bangyan had rebelled in Guizhou, and Chongming relied remotely on him for support.

sentences.zh: 三年，川師復遵義，進攻永寧，遇奢寅於土地坎，率兵搏戰。

translations.literal: In the third year Sichuan troops recovered Zunyi, advanced to attack Yongning, met She Yin at Tudikan, and led troops in hand-to-hand battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Sichuan troops recovered Zunyi and advanced on Yongning. They met She Yin at Tudikan and fought hand to hand.

sentences.zh: 大兵奮擊，敗之。

translations.literal: The great army struck fiercely and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The main army struck fiercely and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 寅被創遁，樊虎亦戰死。

translations.literal: Yin, wounded, fled; Fan Hu also died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Yin, wounded, fled. Fan Hu also died in battle.

sentences.zh: 進克其城，降賊二萬。

translations.literal: Advancing they took his city and received the surrender of twenty thousand bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing, they took his city and received the surrender of twenty thousand rebels.

sentences.zh: 得進拔紅崖、天臺諸囤寨，降者日至。

translations.literal: They were able to advance and take the stockades of Hongya, Tiantai, and others; submitters came day by day.
translations.idiomatic: They advanced and took the stockades of Hongya, Tiantai, and others. Submitters came day by day.

sentences.zh: 崇明勢益蹙，求救於水西，邦彥遣十六營過河援之。

translations.literal: Chongming's situation grew ever more pressed; he begged aid from Shuixi; Bangyan sent sixteen camps across the river to aid him.
translations.idiomatic: Chongming's situation grew desperate. He begged aid from Shuixi, and Bangyan sent sixteen camps across the river to aid him.

sentences.zh: 羅乾象急破蘭州，焚九鳳樓，覆其巢。

translations.literal: Luo Qianxiang urgently broke Lanzhou, burned Jiufeng Tower, and overturned their nest.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Qianxiang urgently overran Lanzhou, burned Jiufeng Tower, and destroyed their base.

sentences.zh: 崇明踉蹌走，投水西。

translations.literal: Chongming fled stumbling and threw himself on Shuixi.
translations.idiomatic: Chongming fled in disorder and threw himself on Shuixi.

sentences.zh: 邦彥與合兵，分犯遵義、永寧。

translations.literal: Bangyan joined forces with him and divided to invade Zunyi and Yongning.
translations.idiomatic: Bangyan joined forces with him and divided to invade Zunyi and Yongning.

sentences.zh: 川師敗之於芝麻塘，賊遁入青山。

translations.literal: Sichuan troops defeated them at Zhimatang; the bandits fled into Qingshan.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan troops defeated them at Zhimatang. The rebels fled into Qingshan.

sentences.zh: 諸將逼渭河，鏖入龍場陣，獲崇明妻安氏及奢崇輝等，斬獲萬計。

translations.literal: The generals pressed the Wei River, fought fiercely into the Longchang formation, captured Chongming's wife Lady An and She Chonghui and others, and killed or captured tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: The generals pressed the Wei River, fought fiercely into the Longchang formation, captured Chongming's wife Lady An and She Chonghui and others, and killed or captured tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 蘭州平。

translations.literal: Lanzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Lanzhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 總督朱燮元請以赤水河為界，河東龍場屬黔，河西赤水、永寧屬蜀。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Zhu Xieyuan asked that the Chishui River be the border: east of the river Longchang belong to Qian, west of the river Chishui and Yongning to Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Zhu Xieyuan proposed that the Chishui River serve as the border: Longchang east of the river would belong to Qian, and Chishui and Yongning west of the river to Shu.

sentences.zh: 永寧設道、府，與遵義、建武聲勢聯絡。

translations.literal: A circuit and prefecture were established at Yongning, linking forces with Zunyi and Jianwu.
translations.idiomatic: A circuit and prefecture were established at Yongning, linking forces with Zunyi and Jianwu.

sentences.zh: 未幾，貴州巡撫王三善為邦彥所襲死，崇明勢復張，將以逾春大舉寇永寧。

translations.literal: Before long Guizhou Grand Coordinator Wang Shanshan was killed in an attack by Bangyan; Chongming's power swelled again and he planned a great raid on Yongning after the new year.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Guizhou Grand Coordinator Wang Shanshan was killed in an attack by Bangyan. Chongming's power swelled again, and he planned a great raid on Yongning after the new year.

sentences.zh: 會奢寅為其下所殺，而燮元亦以父喪去，崇明、邦彥得稽誅。

translations.literal: It happened that She Yin was killed by his subordinates, and Xieyuan also left for his father's mourning; Chongming and Bangyan were able to delay punishment.
translations.idiomatic: She Yin was killed by his subordinates, and Xieyuan left for his father's mourning. Chongming and Bangyan were able to delay punishment.

sentences.zh: 崇明稱大梁王，邦彥號四裔大長老，諸稱元帥者不可勝計，合兵十余萬，規先犯赤水。

translations.literal: Chongming styled himself King of Great Liang; Bangyan called himself Great Elder of the Four Frontiers; those styling themselves marshals were beyond counting; combined troops exceeded one hundred thousand; they planned first to invade Chishui.
translations.idiomatic: Chongming styled himself King of Great Liang. Bangyan called himself Great Elder of the Four Frontiers. Countless men styled themselves marshals. Their combined forces exceeded one hundred thousand, and they planned first to invade Chishui.

sentences.zh: 崇禎初，起燮元總督貴、湖、雲、川、廣諸軍務，大會師。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongzhen, Xieyuan was raised as grand coordinator of military affairs in Qian, Hu, Yun, Chuan, and Guang, and a great army assembled.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Chongzhen, Xieyuan was appointed grand coordinator of military affairs in Qian, Hu, Yun, Chuan, and Guang, and a great army assembled.

sentences.zh: 燮元定計誘賊深入向永寧，邀之於五峰山桃紅壩，令總兵侯良柱大敗之，崇明、邦彥皆授首。

translations.literal: Xieyuan fixed a plan to lure the bandits deep toward Yongning and intercept them at Taohongba on Wufeng Mountain; he ordered Grand Commander Hou Liangzhu to defeat them greatly; Chongming and Bangyan both lost their heads.
translations.idiomatic: Xieyuan fixed a plan to lure the rebels deep toward Yongning and intercept them at Taohongba on Wufeng Mountain. Grand Commander Hou Liangzhu defeated them greatly, and Chongming and Bangyan both lost their heads.

sentences.zh: 是役也，掃蕩蜀、黔數十年巨憝，前後皆燮元功雲。

translations.literal: In this campaign the great scourges of Shu and Qian for several decades were swept away; before and after it was all Xieyuan's merit.
translations.idiomatic: In this campaign the great scourges of Shu and Qian for several decades were swept away. Before and after, the credit was Xieyuan's.

sentences.zh: 酉陽宣撫司

translations.literal: Youyang Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office
translations.idiomatic: The Youyang Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office

sentences.zh: 酉陽，漢武陵郡酉陽縣地，宋為酉陽州。

translations.literal: Youyang was the land of Youyang County in Han's Wuling commandery; under the Song it was Youyang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Youyang was the territory of Youyang County in the Han dynasty's Wuling commandery. Under the Song it became Youyang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元屬懷德府。

translations.literal: Under the Yuan it belonged to Huaide Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Huaide Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武五年，酉陽軍民宣慰司冉如彪遣弟如喜來朝貢。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Hongwu the Youyang Military-Civilian Pacification Commissioner Ran Rubiao sent his younger brother Ruxi to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Hongwu, Youyang Military-Civilian Pacification Commissioner Ran Rubiao sent his younger brother Ruxi to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 置酉陽州，以如彪為知州。

translations.literal: Youyang Prefecture was established with Rubiao as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Youyang Prefecture was established with Rubiao as prefect.

sentences.zh: 八年改為宣撫司，仍以冉如彪為使。

translations.literal: In the eighth year it was changed to a Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office, still with Ran Rubiao as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year it became a Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office, with Ran Rubiao still as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 置平茶、邑梅、麻兔、石耶四洞長官司，以楊底綱、楊金奉、冉德原、楊隆為之，每三年一入貢。

translations.literal: The four cave Native Official Offices of Pingcha, Yimei, Matu, and Shiye were established, with Yang Digang, Yang Jinfeng, Ran Deyuan, and Yang Long appointed; tribute was presented once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: The four cave Native Official Offices of Pingcha, Yimei, Matu, and Shiye were established, with Yang Digang, Yang Jinfeng, Ran Deyuan, and Yang Long appointed. Tribute was presented once every three years.

sentences.zh: 石耶不能親至京，命附於酉陽。

translations.literal: Shiye could not come in person to the capital and was ordered attached to Youyang.
translations.idiomatic: Shiye could not come in person to the capital and was ordered to present tribute through Youyang.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，平茶洞署長官楊再勝，謀殺兄子正賢及洞長楊通保等。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year the acting native official of Pingcha Cave Yang Zaisheng plotted to kill his elder brother's son Zhengxian and Cave Chief Yang Tongbao and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year the acting native official of Pingcha Cave, Yang Zaisheng, plotted to kill his elder brother's son Zhengxian and Cave Chief Yang Tongbao and others.

sentences.zh: 正賢等覺之，逃至京師，訴其事，且言再勝與景川侯謀反。

translations.literal: Zhengxian and others discovered it, fled to the capital, complained of the matter, and also said Zaisheng was plotting rebellion with the Jingchuan Marquis.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengxian and others discovered the plot, fled to the capital, and complained that Zaisheng was plotting rebellion with the Jingchuan Marquis.

sentences.zh: 帝命逮再勝鞫之，再勝辭服，當族誅，正賢亦應緣坐。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Zaisheng arrested and tried; Zaisheng confessed guilt and merited execution of the whole clan; Zhengxian also should be punished by association.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Zaisheng arrested and tried. Zaisheng confessed guilt and merited execution of the whole clan. Zhengxian also should be punished by association.

sentences.zh: 帝誅再勝，釋正賢，使襲長官。

translations.literal: The Emperor executed Zaisheng, released Zhengxian, and had him inherit the native office.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor executed Zaisheng, released Zhengxian, and had him inherit the native office.

sentences.zh: 酉陽宣撫冉興邦以襲職來朝，命改隸渝州。

translations.literal: Youyang Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ran Xingbang came to court on inheriting office and was ordered transferred to subordination under Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Youyang Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ran Xingbang came to court on inheriting office and was placed under Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 永樂三年，指揮丁能、杜福撫諭亞堅等十一寨生苗一百三十六戶，各遣子入朝，命隸酉陽宣撫司。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongle Commanders Ding Neng and Du Fu summoned and instructed the raw Miao of eleven stockades including Yajian, one hundred thirty-six households, each sent sons to court, and they were ordered subordinate to the Youyang Pacification Assistant Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongle, Commanders Ding Neng and Du Fu summoned and instructed the raw Miao of eleven stockades including Yajian, one hundred thirty-six households. Each sent sons to court, and they were placed under the Youyang Pacification Assistant Commission.

sentences.zh: 四年免酉陽荒田租。

translations.literal: In the fourth year rent on Youyang wasteland was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, rent on Youyang wasteland was remitted.

sentences.zh: 五年，興邦遣部長龔俊等貢方物，並謝立儒學恩。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Xingbang sent headmen Gong Jun and others to present local products and also thanked the grace of establishing a Confucian school.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Xingbang sent headmen Gong Jun and others to present local products and thank the court for establishing a Confucian school.

sentences.zh: 景泰七年調宣撫僉事冉廷璋兵，征五開、銅鼓叛苗，賜敕諭賞賚。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jingtai the troops of Pacification Assistant Vice Commissioner Ran Tingzhang were mobilized to campaign against the rebellious Miao of Wukai and Tonggu; an edict with rewards was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Jingtai the troops of Pacification Assistant Vice Commissioner Ran Tingzhang were mobilized against the rebellious Miao of Wukai and Tonggu. An edict with rewards was granted.

sentences.zh: 天順十三年命進宣撫冉雲散官一階，以助討叛苗及擒石全州之功也。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Tianshun Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ran Yun was advanced one rank in honorary office for merit in assisting to suppress rebellious Miao and capturing Shiquan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Tianshun, Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ran Yun was advanced one rank in honorary office for assisting in the suppression of rebellious Miao and capturing Shiquan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 弘治七年，宣撫冉舜臣以征貴州叛苗功，乞升職。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Hongzhi Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ran Shunchen, for merit in campaigning against Guizhou rebellious Miao, begged promotion in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Hongzhi, Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ran Shunchen begged promotion for merit in campaigning against Guizhou rebellious Miao.

sentences.zh: 兵部以非例，請進舜臣階明威將軍，賜敕褒之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War, because it was not precedent, asked to advance Shunchen to the rank General of Manifest Might and grant an edict praising him.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War, because it was not precedent, advanced Shunchen to the rank General of Manifest Might and granted an edict praising him.

sentences.zh: 十二年，舜臣奏宋農寨蠻賊糾脅諸寨洞蠻，殺掠焚劫，乞剿捕。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Shunchen memorialized that Songnong stockade barbarian bandits had coerced various stockade and cave barbarians to kill, plunder, burn, and rob, and begged suppression and capture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Shunchen memorialized that Songnong stockade rebels had coerced various stockade and cave tribes to kill, plunder, burn, and rob, and begged suppression.

sentences.zh: 保靖、永順二宣慰亦奏，邑梅副長官楊勝剛父子謀據酉陽，結俊倍洞長楊廣震等，號召宋農、後溪諸蠻，聚兵殺掠，請並討。
