translations.literal: The Pacification Commissioners of Baojing and Yongshun also memorialized that Yimei Vice Native Official Yang Shenggang father and son plotted to seize Youyang, joined Junbei Cave Chief Yang Guangzhen and others, summoned the barbarians of Songnong and Houxi, gathered troops to kill and plunder, and asked joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioners of Baojing and Yongshun also memorialized that Yimei Vice Native Official Yang Shenggang and his son plotted to seize Youyang, joined Junbei Cave Chief Yang Guangzhen and others, summoned the tribes of Songnong and Houxi, gathered troops to kill and plunder, and asked for joint suppression.

sentences.zh: 兵部議，酉陽溪洞連絡，易煽動，宜即撲滅，請行鎮巡官酌機宜。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War deliberated that Youyang's streams and caves were linked and easily stirred; they should immediately be extinguished; frontier officials should be ordered to weigh circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War held that Youyang's streams and caves were linked and easily stirred. They should be extinguished immediately, and frontier officials should weigh circumstances.

sentences.zh: 十四年調酉陽兵五千協剿貴州賊婦米魯。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year five thousand Youyang troops were mobilized to assist in suppressing the Guizhou bandit woman Milu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year five thousand Youyang troops were mobilized to assist in suppressing the Guizhou rebel Milu.

sentences.zh: 正德三年，酉陽宣撫司護印舍人冉廷璽及邑梅長官司奏，湖廣鎮溪所洞苗聚眾攻劫，請兵剿捕。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhengde the Youyang Pacification Assistant Commission seal-guarding steward Ran Tingxi and the Yimei Native Official Office memorialized that Miao of Zhenxi Guard caves in Huguang gathered to attack and plunder, and begged troops to suppress and capture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhengde, Youyang Pacification Assistant Commission seal-guarding steward Ran Tingxi and the Yimei Native Official Office memorialized that Miao of Zhenxi Guard caves in Huguang had gathered to attack and plunder, and begged troops to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 八年，宣撫冉元獻大木二十，乞免男維翰襲職赴京，從之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ran Yuan presented twenty great timbers and begged that his son Weihan be excused from inheriting office and coming to the capital; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ran Yuan presented twenty great timbers and begged that his son Weihan be excused from inheriting office and coming to the capital. The court approved.

sentences.zh: 二十年，元再獻大木二十，詔量加服色酬賞。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Yuan again presented twenty great timbers; an edict ordered added robes and insignia as reward in measure.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Yuan again presented twenty great timbers. An edict ordered added robes and insignia as reward.

sentences.zh: 萬歷十七年，宣撫再維屏獻大木二十，價逾三千。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Wanli Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ran Weiping again presented twenty great timbers worth more than three thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Wanli, Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ran Weiping presented twenty great timbers worth more than three thousand.

sentences.zh: 工部議，應加從三品服，以為土官輸誠之勸，從之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Works deliberated that he should receive robes of rank 3b as encouragement for native officials' loyal submission; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Works held that he should receive robes of rank 3b as encouragement for native officials' loyal submission. The court approved.

sentences.zh: 四十六年調酉陽兵四千，命宣撫冉躍龍將之援遼。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year four thousand Youyang troops were mobilized and Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ran Yuelong ordered to lead them to aid Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year four thousand Youyang troops were mobilized, and Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ran Yuelong was ordered to lead them to aid Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，躍龍遣子天胤及文光等領兵赴遼陽，駐虎皮、黃山等處三載，解奉集之圍。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year Yuelong sent his son Tianyin and Wenguang and others leading troops to Liaoyang, encamped at Hupi, Huangshan, and other places for three years, and relieved the siege of Fengji.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year Yuelong sent his son Tianyin and Wenguang and others with troops to Liaoyang. They encamped at Hupi, Huangshan, and other places for three years and relieved the siege of Fengji.

sentences.zh: 再援沈陽，以渾河失利，冉見龍戰沒，死者千余人。

translations.literal: Again aiding Shenyang, they were defeated at the Hun River; Ran Jianlong died in battle and more than a thousand died.
translations.idiomatic: Again aiding Shenyang, they were defeated at the Hun River. Ran Jianlong died in battle, and more than a thousand died.

sentences.zh: 撤守遼陽，又以降敵縱火，冉文煥等戰沒，死者七百余人。

translations.literal: Withdrawing the garrison from Liaoyang, surrendered enemies again set fire; Ran Wenhuan and others died in battle and more than seven hundred died.
translations.idiomatic: Withdrawing the garrison from Liaoyang, surrendered enemies set fire again. Ran Wenhuan and others died in battle, and more than seven hundred died.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書張鶴鳴言：「躍龍遣子弟萬里勤王，見龍既殺身殉國，躍龍又自捐金二千兩，運軍器至山海關，振困招魂，忠義可嘉。

translations.literal: Minister of War Zhang Heming said: "Yuelong sent sons and younger brothers ten thousand li to serve the throne; Jianlong already gave his life for the state; Yuelong also personally donated two thousand taels of gold, transported weapons to Shanhaiguan, revived the weary and summoned souls—loyalty and righteousness are praiseworthy."
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Zhang Heming said: "Yuelong sent sons and younger brothers ten thousand li to serve the throne. Jianlong gave his life for the state. Yuelong personally donated two thousand taels of gold, transported weapons to Shanhaiguan, and revived the weary. His loyalty and righteousness are praiseworthy."

sentences.zh: 臣在貴州時，躍龍亦自捐餉征紅苗，屢建奇功。

translations.literal: When your servant was in Guizhou, Yuelong also personally donated supplies to campaign against the Red Miao and repeatedly achieved strange merit.
translations.idiomatic: When your servant was in Guizhou, Yuelong also personally donated supplies to campaign against the Red Miao and repeatedly achieved great merit.

sentences.zh: 今又著節於邊，宜加優恤，以風諸邊。」

translations.literal: Now he again shows integrity on the frontier; generous favor should be added to inspire all frontiers."
translations.idiomatic: Now he has again shown integrity on the frontier. Generous favor should be granted to inspire all frontiers."

sentences.zh: 天啟元年授躍龍宣慰使，並妻舒氏，皆給誥命，仍恤陣亡千七百余家。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianqi Yuelong was granted Pacification Commissioner and his wife Lady Shu as well; both were given patents of appointment, and the more than seventeen hundred families killed in battle were still favored.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianqi, Yuelong was granted the rank of Pacification Commissioner, and his wife Lady Shu as well. Both received patents of appointment, and more than seventeen hundred families killed in battle were granted relief.

sentences.zh: 二年，奢崇明叛，躍龍率援師合圍重慶。

translations.literal: In the second year She Chongming rebelled; Yuelong led relief troops in joint siege of Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year She Chongming rebelled. Yuelong led relief troops in the joint siege of Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 及崇明誅，其土舍冉紹文與有功。

translations.literal: When Chongming was executed, his native steward Ran Shaowen had merit in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: When Chongming was executed, his native steward Ran Shaowen had merit in the affair.

sentences.zh: 四年，躍龍以東西赴調效命，為弟見龍及諸陣亡者請賚恤。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Yuelong, because he had answered summons east and west and performed service, asked rewards and relief for his younger brother Jianlong and all those killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Yuelong, having answered summons east and west and performed service, asked rewards and relief for his younger brother Jianlong and all those killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 命下所司。

translations.literal: An order was sent down to the responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: An order was sent to the responsible offices.

sentences.zh: 崇禎九年，宣慰使冉天麟疏言：「庶孽天胤假旨謀奪臣爵土，不遂，擅兵戕殺。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Chongzhen Pacification Commissioner Ran Tianlin memorialized: "The illegitimate son Tianyin falsely used an edict to plot seizing your servant's rank and land; failing, he mobilized troops and slaughtered."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Chongzhen, Pacification Commissioner Ran Tianlin memorialized: "The illegitimate son Tianyin falsely used an edict to plot seizing my rank and land. Failing, he mobilized troops and slaughtered."

sentences.zh: 」下撫按察勘。

translations.literal: The matter was sent down to grand coordinators and censors for investigation.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was sent to grand coordinators and censors for investigation.

sentences.zh: 時蜀方憂盜，大吏自顧不暇，土官事多寢閣雲。

translations.literal: At the time Shu was troubled by bandits; high officials could not spare themselves; native official matters were mostly shelved.
translations.idiomatic: Shu was then troubled by bandits, and high officials could not spare attention. Native official matters were mostly shelved.

sentences.zh: 石砫宣撫司

translations.literal: Shizhu Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office
translations.idiomatic: The Shizhu Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office

sentences.zh: 石砫，以石潼關、砫薄關而名。

translations.literal: Shizhu is named for Shitong Pass and Zhubo Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhu is named for Shitong Pass and Zhubo Pass.

sentences.zh: 後周置施州。

translations.literal: The Later Zhou established Shi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Later Zhou established Shi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 唐改青江郡。

translations.literal: The Tang changed it to Qingjiang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang redesignated it Qingjiang commandery.

sentences.zh: 宋末，置石砫安撫司。

translations.literal: Late in the Song the Shizhu Pacification Assistant Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Song the Shizhu Pacification Assistant Commission was established.

sentences.zh: 元改石砫軍民府，尋仍為安撫司。

translations.literal: The Yuan changed it to the Shizhu Military-Civilian Prefecture, soon again a Pacification Assistant Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan changed it to the Shizhu Military-Civilian Prefecture, soon restored as a Pacification Assistant Commission.

sentences.zh: 洪武七年，石砫安撫使馬克用遣其子付德與同知陳世顯入朝，貢方物。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Hongwu Shizhu Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ma Keyong sent his son Fude and Vice Commissioner Chen Shixian to court with local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Hongwu, Shizhu Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ma Keyong sent his son Fude and Vice Commissioner Chen Shixian to court with local tribute.

sentences.zh: 八年，改石砫安撫司為宣撫司，隸重慶府。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the Shizhu Pacification Assistant Commission was changed to a Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office subordinate to Chongqing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the Shizhu Pacification Assistant Commission became a Pacification Assistant Commissioner's Office subordinate to Chongqing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十六年，石砫溪蠻寇施州，黔江守禦官軍擊破之。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Shizhu stream barbarians raided Shi Prefecture; Qianjiang garrison troops defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Shizhu stream tribes raided Shi Prefecture. Qianjiang garrison troops defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十八年，石砫宣撫同知陳世顯遣子興潮等奉表貢方物，賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Shizhu Pacification Assistant Vice Commissioner Chen Shixian sent his son Xingchao and others presenting a memorial and local products, congratulating the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Shizhu Pacification Assistant Vice Commissioner Chen Shixian sent his son Xingchao and others with a memorial and local tribute to congratulate the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 二十四年賜石砫宣撫同知陳興潮及其子文義白金百兩，以從征散毛洞有功故也。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Shizhu Pacification Assistant Vice Commissioner Chen Xingchao and his son Wenyi were granted one hundred taels of white gold for merit in campaigning against Sanmao Cave.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Shizhu Pacification Assistant Vice Commissioner Chen Xingchao and his son Wenyi were granted one hundred taels of white gold for merit in campaigning against Sanmao Cave.

sentences.zh: 宣德五年命宣撫馬應仁子鎮為宣撫。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xuande Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ma Yingren's son Zhen was appointed Pacification Assistant Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xuande, Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ma Yingren's son Zhen was appointed Pacification Assistant Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 初，應仁有罪應死，貸謫戍。

translations.literal: Earlier Yingren had guilt meriting death and was lent exile to garrison service.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Yingren had committed a capital crime and was spared for exile to garrison service.

sentences.zh: 至是，帝念其祖克用嘗效力先朝，命求其子孫之良者用之，故有是命。

translations.literal: At this time the Emperor, recalling that his grandfather Keyong had once served the former court with effort, ordered that good descendants be sought and employed; therefore there was this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, recalling that his grandfather Keyong had served the former court, ordered that a worthy descendant be found and appointed. Hence this order.

sentences.zh: 成化十八年，四川巡撫孫仁奏：「三月內盜三百人入石砫，殺宣撫馬澄及隸卒二十余人，焚掠而去。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Chenghua Sichuan Grand Coordinator Sun Ren memorialized: "Within the third month three hundred bandits entered Shizhu, killed Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ma Cheng and more than twenty attendants and soldiers, burned and plundered, and left."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Chenghua, Sichuan Grand Coordinator Sun Ren memorialized: "Within the third month three hundred bandits entered Shizhu, killed Pacification Assistant Commissioner Ma Cheng and more than twenty attendants and soldiers, burned and plundered, and left."

sentences.zh: 以石砫地鄰酆都，互爭銀場相訐，有司不為區治，致相仇殺。

translations.literal: Because Shizhu land borders Fengdu, they disputed silver mines and accused one another; the authorities did not demarcate and govern, causing mutual killing in enmity.
translations.idiomatic: Because Shizhu borders Fengdu, they disputed silver mines and accused one another. The authorities did not settle the matter, causing mutual killing.

sentences.zh: 」命責有司捕賊。

translations.literal: An order commanded the responsible offices to capture the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the responsible offices to capture the bandits.

sentences.zh: 仁奏：「石砫歲辦鉛課五千一百三十斤，正統後停之。

translations.literal: Ren memorialized: "Shizhu yearly supplied lead tax of five thousand one hundred thirty jin; after Zhengtong it was halted."
translations.idiomatic: Ren memorialized: "Shizhu yearly supplied five thousand one hundred thirty jin of lead tax. After Zhengtong it was halted."

sentences.zh: 鄰境軍民假以征課，乘機竊取，釀成禍階。

translations.literal: Neighboring soldiers and civilians used tax collection as a pretext and seized the opportunity to steal, brewing the steps of calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Neighboring soldiers and civilians used tax collection as a pretext to steal, brewing calamity.

sentences.zh: 請除其課，閉其洞，仍移忠州臨江巡檢於酆都南賓裏之姜池，以便防守。

translations.literal: I beg to remit its tax, close its mines, and still move the Linjiang inspector of Zhong Prefecture to Jiangchi in Nanbinli of Fengdu for convenient defense.
translations.idiomatic: I beg to remit its tax, close its mines, and move the Linjiang inspector of Zhong Prefecture to Jiangchi in Nanbinli of Fengdu for convenient defense.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 是年，命馬徽為宣撫。

translations.literal: That year Ma Hui was appointed Pacification Assistant Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ma Hui was appointed Pacification Assistant Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 萬歷二十二年，石砫女土官覃氏行宣撫事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Wanli the female native official of Shizhu, Lady Qin, administered Pacification Assistant affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year of Wanli, the female native official of Shizhu, Lady Qin, administered Pacification Assistant affairs.

sentences.zh: 土吏馬邦聘謀奪其印，與其黨馬鬥斛、鬥霖等，集眾數千，圍覃氏，縱火焚公私廬舍八十余所，殺掠一空。

translations.literal: Native clerk Ma Bangpin plotted to seize her seal; with his followers Ma Douhu, Doulin, and others he gathered several thousand, besieged Lady Qin, set fire and burned more than eighty public and private buildings, and killed and plundered everything.
translations.idiomatic: Native clerk Ma Bangpin plotted to seize her seal. With his followers Ma Douhu, Doulin, and others he gathered several thousand men, besieged Lady Qin, burned more than eighty public and private buildings, and killed and plundered everything.

sentences.zh: 覃氏上書言：「臣自從征疊、茂，擊賊大雪山，斬首捕寇，皆著有成勞，屢膺上官獎賞。

translations.literal: Lady Qin memorialized upward: "Your servant from campaigning in Die and Mao, striking bandits at Great Snow Mountain, cutting heads and capturing raiders, all showed established merit and repeatedly received rewards from superiors."
translations.idiomatic: Lady Qin memorialized: "Your servant, in campaigning in Die and Mao and striking bandits at Great Snow Mountain, cutting heads and capturing raiders, has shown established merit and repeatedly received rewards from superiors."

sentences.zh: 今邦聘無故虔劉孤寡，臣豈不能出一旅與之角勝負，誠以非朝命，不敢也。

translations.literal: Now Bangpin without cause slaughtered the orphaned and widowed; could your servant not send one column to contest victory with him? Truly because it is not the court's command, I dare not.
translations.idiomatic: Now Bangpin has slaughtered the orphaned and widowed without cause. I could send troops to contest victory with him, but I dare not without the court's command.

sentences.zh: 今叛人斯在，請比先年楚金洞舍覃碧謀篡事，願與邦聘同就吏。

translations.literal: Now the rebel is here; I beg comparison with the earlier affair when Chujindong steward Qin Bi plotted usurpation; I am willing to come to judgment together with Bangpin.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel is here. I beg comparison with the earlier affair when Chujindong steward Qin Bi plotted usurpation. I am willing to come to judgment together with Bangpin.

sentences.zh: 」二十三年命四川撫，按讞其獄，事未決。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Sichuan grand coordinators and censors were ordered to judge the case; the matter was not decided.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Sichuan grand coordinators and censors were ordered to judge the case. The matter was not decided.

sentences.zh: 會楊應龍反播州，覃與應龍為姻，而鬥斛亦結應龍，兩家觀望，獄遂解。

translations.literal: It happened that Yang Yinglong rebelled in Bozhou; Qin was affined to Yinglong, and Douhu also joined Yinglong; both families watched and waited, and the case was then dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yinglong rebelled in Bozhou. Qin was allied to Yinglong by marriage, and Douhu also joined Yinglong. Both families waited and watched, and the case was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 覃氏有智計，性淫，故與應龍通。

translations.literal: Lady Qin had stratagems and was licentious by nature; therefore she communicated with Yinglong.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Qin was clever and licentious by nature and therefore had relations with Yinglong.

sentences.zh: 長子千乘失愛，匿次子千駟，謂應龍可恃，因聘其女為千駟妻。

translations.literal: The eldest son Qiancheng lost favor; she hid the second son Qiansi, held that Yinglong could be relied on, and therefore betrothed his daughter to Qiansi as wife.
translations.idiomatic: The eldest son Qiancheng lost favor. She hid the second son Qiansi, held that Yinglong could be relied on, and betrothed his daughter to Qiansi.

sentences.zh: 千駟入播，同應龍反。

translations.literal: Qiansi entered Bozhou and rebelled together with Yinglong.
translations.idiomatic: Qiansi entered Bozhou and rebelled together with Yinglong.

sentences.zh: 千乘襲馬氏爵，應調，與酉陽冉禦龍同征應龍。

translations.literal: Qiancheng inherited the Ma clan rank, answered mobilization, and with Youyang's Ran Yulong jointly campaigned against Yinglong.
translations.idiomatic: Qiancheng inherited the Ma clan rank, answered mobilization, and with Youyang's Ran Yulong jointly campaigned against Yinglong.

sentences.zh: 應龍敗。

translations.literal: Yinglong was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong was defeated.

sentences.zh: 千駟伏誅，而千乘為宣撫如故。

translations.literal: Qiansi was executed in secret, while Qiancheng remained Pacification Assistant Commissioner as before.
translations.idiomatic: Qiansi was executed, while Qiancheng remained Pacification Assistant Commissioner as before.

sentences.zh: 千乘卒，妻秦良玉以功封夫人，自有傳。

translations.literal: Qiancheng died; his wife Qin Liangyu was enfeoffed as lady for merit and has her own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Qiancheng died. His wife Qin Liangyu was enfeoffed as lady for merit and has her own biography.
